CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.han_finish_send(
  p_company uuid,
  p_request uuid,
  p_status text,
  p_mid text
)
RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE
  v_row private.han_outbox%ROWTYPE;
  v_conversation public.conversations%ROWTYPE;
  v_interaction public.interactions%ROWTYPE;
  v_sent_at timestamptz;
  v_now timestamptz := clock_timestamp();
  v_sla_rows integer := 0;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_row
  FROM private.han_outbox
  WHERE company_id = p_company
    AND request_id = p_request
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND
      OR p_status NOT IN ('SENT', 'FAILED', 'UNKNOWN')
      OR (
        p_status = 'SENT'
        AND coalesce(length(p_mid), 0) = 0
      )
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_RESULT';
  END IF;

  IF v_row.status <> 'SENDING' THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_conversation
  FROM public.conversations
  WHERE id = v_row.conversation_id
    AND company_id = p_company;

  IF p_status = 'SENT' THEN
    v_sent_at := clock_timestamp();

    -- Validate interaction integrity: must be an OUTBOUND MESSAGE
    SELECT * INTO v_interaction
    FROM public.interactions
    WHERE id = v_row.interaction_id;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'INTERACTION_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
    END IF;

    IF v_interaction.type <> 'MESSAGE' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_INTERACTION_TYPE' USING ERRCODE = '22000';
    END IF;

    IF v_interaction.direction <> 'OUTBOUND' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_INTERACTION_DIRECTION' USING ERRCODE = '22000';
    END IF;

    UPDATE private.han_outbox
    SET status = p_status,
        provider_mid = p_mid,
        sent_at = v_sent_at
    WHERE company_id = p_company
      AND request_id = p_request;

    UPDATE public.interactions
    SET external_ref =
          split_part(v_conversation.external_conversation_id, ':', 1)
              || ':' || p_mid
    WHERE id = v_row.interaction_id;

    UPDATE public.conversations
    SET last_message_at = greatest(last_message_at, v_sent_at),
        status = CASE WHEN status = 'AI_HANDLING' THEN 'OPEN' ELSE status END
    WHERE id = v_row.conversation_id;

    -- Update Response SLA window: strictly bound to dispatch_delivery_id == p_request and dispatch_owner = 'SALE'
    -- SOLE transition mechanism; zero fallback to legacy resolver
    UPDATE public.response_sla_windows
    SET state = 'SALE_RESPONDED',
        sale_response_interaction_id = v_row.interaction_id,
        resolved_at = v_sent_at,
        dispatch_owner = 'SALE',
        dispatch_state = 'PROVIDER_ACCEPTED',
        dispatch_fenced_until = NULL,
        ai_dispatch_fenced_until = NULL,
        ai_dispatch_token = NULL,
        updated_at = v_sent_at
    WHERE conversation_id = v_row.conversation_id
      AND (state = 'OPEN' OR (state = 'OPEN' AND dispatch_state = 'UNCERTAIN'))
      AND dispatch_delivery_id = p_request
      AND dispatch_owner = 'SALE';

    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_sla_rows = ROW_COUNT;
    -- If v_sla_rows = 0, p_request was not the active dispatch owner of this window;
    -- outbox is updated above but active SLA window is strictly NOT mutated or resolved.

  ELSIF p_status = 'FAILED' THEN
    UPDATE private.han_outbox
    SET status = p_status,
        provider_mid = p_mid
    WHERE company_id = p_company
      AND request_id = p_request;

    UPDATE public.response_sla_windows
    SET dispatch_owner = 'NONE',
        dispatch_state = 'FAILED',
        dispatch_token = NULL,
        dispatch_fenced_until = NULL,
        dispatch_delivery_id = NULL,
        updated_at = v_now
    WHERE conversation_id = v_row.conversation_id
      AND state = 'OPEN'
      AND dispatch_delivery_id = p_request
      AND dispatch_owner = 'SALE';

  ELSE -- UNKNOWN / network ambiguity
    UPDATE private.han_outbox
    SET status = p_status,
        provider_mid = p_mid
    WHERE company_id = p_company
      AND request_id = p_request;

    UPDATE public.response_sla_windows
    SET dispatch_state = 'UNCERTAIN',
        dispatch_fenced_until = NULL,
        ai_dispatch_fenced_until = NULL,
        updated_at = v_now
    WHERE conversation_id = v_row.conversation_id
      AND state = 'OPEN'
      AND dispatch_delivery_id = p_request
      AND dispatch_owner = 'SALE';
  END IF;

  -- Care delivery updates: NEVER downgrade UNKNOWN to FAILED
  IF v_row.care_delivery_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE public.care_deliveries
    SET
      status = CASE
        WHEN p_status = 'SENT' THEN 'SENT'
        WHEN p_status = 'FAILED' THEN 'FAILED'
        ELSE 'UNCERTAIN'
      END,
      sent_at = CASE
        WHEN p_status = 'SENT' THEN v_sent_at
        ELSE NULL
      END,
      external_message_ref = p_mid,
      updated_at = v_now
    WHERE id = v_row.care_delivery_id
      AND company_id = p_company;

    IF p_status = 'SENT' THEN
      UPDATE public.care_deliveries
      SET status = 'DELIVERED', delivered_at = v_sent_at
      WHERE id = v_row.care_delivery_id
        AND company_id = p_company
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM private.han_receipts r
          WHERE r.company_id = p_company
            AND r.external_identity =
                v_conversation.external_conversation_id
            AND p_mid = ANY(r.mids)
      );

      UPDATE public.care_deliveries
      SET
        status = 'READ',
        delivered_at = coalesce(delivered_at, v_sent_at)
      WHERE id = v_row.care_delivery_id
        AND company_id = p_company
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM private.han_receipts r
          WHERE r.company_id = p_company
            AND r.external_identity =
                v_conversation.external_conversation_id
            AND r.kind = 'READ'
            AND r.watermark >=
                extract(epoch FROM v_row.created_at) * 1000
      );
    END IF;
  END IF;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_order_from_calculation_rpc(
    p_company_id uuid,
    p_customer_id uuid,
    p_price_calculation_id uuid,
    p_payment_reference text,
    p_actor_user_id uuid
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_calc public.price_calculations%ROWTYPE;
    v_existing_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;
    v_order_id uuid;
    v_order_code text;
    v_current_customer_stage text;
BEGIN
    -- Validate actor user ID is provided (no arbitrary or NULL human actor allowed)
    IF p_actor_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'ACTOR_REQUIRED: Actor user ID must be provided';
    END IF;

    -- Validate actor is ACTIVE and has allowed commercial role (BOSS_ADMIN or SALE) in company
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.company_members cm
        JOIN public.user_profiles up ON cm.user_id = up.id
        WHERE cm.company_id = p_company_id
          AND cm.user_id = p_actor_user_id
          AND cm.status = 'ACTIVE'
          AND up.status = 'ACTIVE'
          AND cm.role IN ('BOSS_ADMIN', 'SALE')
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNAUTHORIZED_ROLE: Actor must be active BOSS_ADMIN or SALE in company';
    END IF;

    -- Validate calculation exists and belongs to company & customer (acquires authoritative lock)
    SELECT * INTO v_calc
    FROM public.price_calculations
    WHERE id = p_price_calculation_id AND company_id = p_company_id AND customer_id = p_customer_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF v_calc.id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND: Price calculation not found';
    END IF;

    IF v_calc.status <> 'CALCULATED' OR v_calc.amount IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_PRICE_CALCULATION: Cannot create order from calculation status %', v_calc.status;
    END IF;

    -- Idempotent check: After acquiring lock, re-check for an existing canonical Order
    SELECT * INTO v_existing_order
    FROM public.orders
    WHERE company_id = p_company_id AND price_calculation_id = p_price_calculation_id;

    IF v_existing_order.id IS NOT NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object(
            'status', 'ALREADY_EXISTS',
            'orderId', v_existing_order.id,
            'orderCode', v_existing_order.order_code,
            'finalAmount', v_existing_order.final_amount,
            'depositStatus', v_existing_order.deposit_status,
            'orderStatus', v_existing_order.order_status,
            'paymentReference', v_existing_order.payment_reference
        );
    END IF;

    -- Check customer stage
    SELECT stage INTO v_current_customer_stage
    FROM public.customers
    WHERE id = p_customer_id AND company_id = p_company_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF v_current_customer_stage IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND: Customer not found';
    END IF;

    -- Generate unique order code
    v_order_code := public.generate_order_code();

    -- Insert Order (server authoritative final_amount = calculation.amount)
    INSERT INTO public.orders (
        company_id,
        customer_id,
        order_code,
        payment_reference,
        price_calculation_id,
        deposit_status,
        order_status,
        final_amount
    ) VALUES (
        p_company_id,
        p_customer_id,
        v_order_code,
        p_payment_reference,
        v_calc.id,
        'PENDING',
        'DRAFT',
        v_calc.amount
    ) RETURNING id INTO v_order_id;

    -- Initialize Finance Summary
    INSERT INTO public.finance_summaries (
        order_id,
        company_id,
        contract_value,
        collected_amount,
        receivable_amount,
        completed_revenue
    ) VALUES (
        v_order_id,
        p_company_id,
        v_calc.amount,
        0,
        v_calc.amount,
        0
    );

    -- Update Customer stage to ORDER_CREATED only if customer is in earlier stage
    IF v_current_customer_stage IN ('LEAD_NEW', 'LEAD', 'SURVEY_SCHEDULED', 'SURVEY_COMPLETED', 'PRICE_CALCULATED', 'PRICE_OFFERED', 'NEGOTIATING') THEN
        UPDATE public.customers
        SET stage = 'ORDER_CREATED', updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = p_customer_id;

        INSERT INTO public.customer_stage_histories (
            company_id, customer_id, from_stage, to_stage, actor_type, changed_by_user_id, reason
        ) VALUES (
            p_company_id, p_customer_id, v_current_customer_stage, 'ORDER_CREATED', 'USER', p_actor_user_id, 'Order created from calculation'
        );
    END IF;

    -- Mandatory audit log inserted atomically (failure rolls back mutation)
    INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (
        company_id, user_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, customer_id, result, metadata
    ) VALUES (
        p_company_id,
        p_actor_user_id,
        'ORDER_CREATED',
        'orders',
        v_order_id,
        p_customer_id,
        'SUCCESS',
        jsonb_build_object(
            'order_code', v_order_code,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_outbound_interaction_atomic(
  p_company_id uuid,
  p_conversation_id uuid,
  p_customer_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,
  p_channel text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_sanitized_content text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_raw_content text DEFAULT '',
  p_sanitization_status text DEFAULT 'SUCCEEDED',
  p_source_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  p_client_command_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,
  p_actor_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_conversation public.conversations%ROWTYPE;
  v_customer_id uuid;
  v_channel text;
  v_interaction_id uuid;
  v_delivery_id uuid;
  v_delivery_status text;
  v_existing_fingerprint text;
  v_fingerprint text;
  v_sanitization_status text;
  v_provider text;
  v_now timestamptz := clock_timestamp();
BEGIN
  -- 1. Validate mandatory fields
  IF p_company_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'p_company_id là bắt buộc'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023', HINT = 'MISSING_COMPANY_ID';
  END IF;
  IF p_conversation_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'p_conversation_id là bắt buộc'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023', HINT = 'MISSING_CONVERSATION_ID';
  END IF;

  -- 2. Authenticated Actor Attribution Validation
  IF p_actor_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.company_members cm
      JOIN public.user_profiles up ON up.id = cm.user_id
      JOIN public.companies c ON c.id = cm.company_id
      WHERE cm.company_id = p_company_id
        AND cm.user_id = p_actor_user_id
        AND cm.status = 'ACTIVE'
        AND up.status = 'ACTIVE'
        AND c.status = 'ACTIVE'
        AND cm.role IN ('SALE', 'BOSS_ADMIN', 'ADMIN', 'BOSS')
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'ACTOR_NOT_AUTHORIZED: Người dùng không có quyền gửi tin nhắn hoặc không thuộc tổ chức này.'
        USING ERRCODE = '42501', HINT = 'ACTOR_NOT_AUTHORIZED';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 3. Lock conversation
  SELECT * INTO v_conversation
  FROM public.conversations
  WHERE id = p_conversation_id
    AND company_id = p_company_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND: Cuộc hội thoại không tồn tại hoặc không thuộc quyền quản lý của tổ chức.'
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0002', HINT = 'CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND';
  END IF;

  v_customer_id := coalesce(p_customer_id, v_conversation.customer_id);
  v_channel := coalesce(nullif(upper(trim(p_channel)), ''), v_conversation.channel);
  v_channel := CASE
    WHEN v_channel IN ('FACEBOOK', 'ZALO', 'SYSTEM', 'HOTLINE', 'DIRECT') THEN v_channel
    WHEN upper(trim(v_channel)) = 'FB' THEN 'FACEBOOK'
    WHEN upper(trim(v_channel)) = 'ZL' THEN 'ZALO'
    ELSE 'DIRECT'
  END;

  v_sanitization_status := CASE
    WHEN upper(trim(coalesce(p_sanitization_status, 'SUCCEEDED'))) IN ('CLEAN', 'SANITIZED', 'SUCCEEDED') THEN 'SUCCEEDED'
    WHEN upper(trim(coalesce(p_sanitization_status, 'SUCCEEDED'))) = 'PENDING' THEN 'PENDING'
    WHEN upper(trim(coalesce(p_sanitization_status, 'SUCCEEDED'))) = 'FAILED' THEN 'FAILED'
    WHEN upper(trim(coalesce(p_sanitization_status, 'SUCCEEDED'))) = 'NOT_REQUIRED' THEN 'NOT_REQUIRED'
    ELSE 'SUCCEEDED'
  END;

  v_fingerprint := encode(
    sha256(
      convert_to(
        p_company_id::text || ':' ||
        p_conversation_id::text || ':' ||
        coalesce(v_customer_id::text, '') || ':' ||
        v_channel || ':' ||
        trim(coalesce(p_sanitized_content, '')),
        'UTF8'
      )
    ),
    'hex'
  );

  -- 4. Idempotency Check
  IF p_client_command_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
      hashtextextended(p_company_id::text || ':outbound_cmd:' || p_client_command_id::text, 0)
    );

    SELECT o.interaction_id, o.id, o.delivery_status, o.request_fingerprint
    INTO v_interaction_id, v_delivery_id, v_delivery_status, v_existing_fingerprint
    FROM public.outbound_deliveries o
    WHERE o.company_id = p_company_id
      AND o.client_command_id = p_client_command_id;

    IF FOUND THEN
      IF v_existing_fingerprint IS NOT NULL AND v_existing_fingerprint <> v_fingerprint THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED_WITH_DIFFERENT_PAYLOAD: Lệnh gửi đã được sử dụng với nội dung khác.'
          USING ERRCODE = 'P0001', HINT = 'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED_WITH_DIFFERENT_PAYLOAD';
      END IF;

      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'interaction_id', v_interaction_id,
        'conversation_id', p_conversation_id,
        'customer_id', v_customer_id,
        'channel', v_channel,
        'delivery_id', v_delivery_id,
        'delivery_status', coalesce(v_delivery_status, 'PENDING_DISPATCH'),
        'is_duplicate', true
      );
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 5. Extract provider from conversation metadata
  v_provider := coalesce(v_conversation.metadata->>'provider', 'default');

  v_interaction_id := gen_random_uuid();

  -- Chèn outbound_deliveries
  INSERT INTO public.outbound_deliveries (
    company_id,
    conversation_id,
    interaction_id,
    channel,
    provider,
    content,
    delivery_status,
    status,
    client_command_id,
    idempotency_key,
    request_fingerprint,
    metadata
  ) VALUES (
    p_company_id,
    p_conversation_id,
    v_interaction_id,
    v_channel,
    v_provider,
    coalesce(p_raw_content, p_sanitized_content, ''),
    'PENDING_DISPATCH',
    'PENDING',
    p_client_command_id,
    coalesce(p_client_command_id::text, gen_random_uuid()::text),
    v_fingerprint,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'page_id', v_conversation.metadata->>'page_id',
      'page_name', v_conversation.metadata->>'page_name',
      'customer_fb_id', v_conversation.metadata->>'customer_fb_id',
      'external_conversation_id', v_conversation.metadata->>'external_conversation_id',
      'customer_name', v_conversation.customer_name
    )
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_delivery_id;

  -- 6. Ghi nhận interaction
  INSERT INTO public.interactions (
    id,
    company_id,
    customer_id,
    conversation_id,
    channel,
    type,
    direction,
    sanitized_content,
    sanitization_status,
    sanitized_at,
    sanitizer_version,
    actor_type,
    actor_user_id,
    created_at
  ) VALUES (
    v_interaction_id,
    p_company_id,
    v_customer_id,
    p_conversation_id,
    v_channel,
    'MESSAGE',
    'OUTBOUND',
    p_sanitized_content,
    v_sanitization_status,
    v_now,
    'v1',
    'SALE',
    p_actor_user_id,
    v_now
  );

  -- 7. Ghi nhận raw content
  INSERT INTO private.interaction_raw_contents (
    interaction_id,
    company_id,
    raw_content,
    raw_payload,
    source_metadata,
    created_at
  ) VALUES (
    v_interaction_id,
    p_company_id,
    coalesce(p_raw_content, ''),
    coalesce(p_source_metadata, '{}'::jsonb),
    coalesce(p_source_metadata, '{}'::jsonb),
    v_now
  );

  -- 8. Cập nhật conversations
  UPDATE public.conversations
  SET last_message_at = v_now,
      updated_at = v_now
  WHERE id = p_conversation_id
    AND company_id = p_company_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'interaction_id', v_interaction_id,
    'conversation_id', p_conversation_id,
    'customer_id', v_customer_id,
    'channel', v_channel,
    'delivery_id', v_delivery_id,
    'delivery_status', 'PENDING_DISPATCH',
    'status', 'PENDING',
    'is_duplicate', false
  );
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_facebook_browser_outbox_jobs(
  p_worker_id text,
  p_limit integer DEFAULT 5,
  p_company_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS SETOF public.outbound_deliveries
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  UPDATE public.outbound_deliveries
  SET status = 'PROCESSING',
      delivery_status = 'QUEUED',
      locked_at = clock_timestamp(),
      locked_by = p_worker_id,
      attempt_count = public.outbound_deliveries.attempt_count + 1,
      updated_at = clock_timestamp()
  WHERE id IN (
    SELECT id
    FROM public.outbound_deliveries
    WHERE channel = 'FACEBOOK'
      AND provider = 'facebook_browser'
      AND (
        status = 'PENDING'
        OR (status = 'RETRY' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= clock_timestamp()))
        OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_at < clock_timestamp() - INTERVAL '3 minutes')
      )
      AND (p_company_id IS NULL OR company_id = p_company_id)
    ORDER BY created_at ASC
    LIMIT coalesce(p_limit, 5)
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  )
  RETURNING *;
END;
$$;

BEGIN

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolve_reconciled_facebook_browser_job(
  p_job_id uuid,
  p_resolution text, -- 'SENT', 'RETRY', 'RECONCILE_REQUIRED'
  p_provider_message_id text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_error text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_delivery public.outbound_deliveries%ROWTYPE;
  v_now timestamptz := clock_timestamp();
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_delivery
  FROM public.outbound_deliveries
  WHERE id = p_job_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  IF p_resolution = 'SENT' THEN
    UPDATE public.outbound_deliveries
    SET status = 'SENT',
        delivery_status = 'SENT',
        reconciliation_status = 'RECONCILED_SENT',
        sent_at = v_now,
        delivered_at = v_now,
        last_error = NULL,
        locked_by = NULL,
        locked_at = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL,
        metadata = jsonb_set(
          metadata,
          '{provider_message_id}',
          to_jsonb(coalesce(p_provider_message_id, 'reconciled_confirmed_' || v_now::text))
        ),
        updated_at = v_now
    WHERE id = p_job_id;

    -- Đồng bộ interaction sang SENT nếu có
    IF v_delivery.interaction_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      UPDATE public.interactions
      SET updated_at = v_now
      WHERE id = v_delivery.interaction_id;
    END IF;

    RETURN true;

  ELSIF p_resolution = 'RETRY' THEN
    UPDATE public.outbound_deliveries
    SET status = 'RETRY',
        delivery_status = 'RETRY',
        reconciliation_status = 'RECONCILED_NOT_SENT',
        next_retry_at = v_now + interval '10 seconds',
        last_error = coalesce(p_error, 'RECONCILED_NOT_SENT: Worker crash trước khi gửi, xếp lịch gửi lại an toàn.'),
        locked_by = NULL,
        locked_at = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL,
        updated_at = v_now
    WHERE id = p_job_id;

    RETURN true;

  ELSE -- 'RECONCILE_REQUIRED' (uncertain)
    UPDATE public.outbound_deliveries
    SET status = 'RECONCILE_REQUIRED',
        delivery_status = 'RECONCILE_REQUIRED',
        reconciliation_status = 'RECONCILE_REQUIRED',
        last_error = coalesce(p_error, 'RECONCILE_UNCERTAIN: Không đủ bằng chứng xác định trạng thái gửi. Cần kiểm tra thủ công.'),
        locked_by = NULL,
        locked_at = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL,
        updated_at = v_now
    WHERE id = p_job_id;

    RETURN true;
  END IF;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._han_purge_customer_data(
    p_company uuid,
    p_customer uuid
)
    RETURNS void
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF p_company IS NULL OR p_customer IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_ARGUMENTS';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.customers
    WHERE id = p_customer AND company_id = p_company
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND_IN_TENANT';
  END IF;

  -- 1. Anonymize customer record
  UPDATE public.customers
  SET name = 'Khách hàng đã xóa dữ liệu (Meta Data Deletion)',
      stage = 'LOST',
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = p_customer AND company_id = p_company;

  -- 2. Delete private contact details
  DELETE FROM private.customer_private_contacts
  WHERE customer_id = p_customer AND company_id = p_company;

  -- 3. Delete Facebook identities
  DELETE FROM public.identities
  WHERE customer_id = p_customer AND company_id = p_company AND channel = 'FACEBOOK';

  -- 4. Scrub interaction content
  UPDATE public.interactions
  SET sanitized_content = '[Dữ liệu cá nhân đã xóa theo yêu cầu Data Deletion của người dùng]',
      sanitization_status = 'SUCCEEDED',
      external_ref = 'del_' || id::text
  WHERE customer_id = p_customer AND company_id = p_company;

  -- 5. Close conversations
  UPDATE public.conversations
  SET status = 'CLOSED',
      unread_count = 0
  WHERE customer_id = p_customer AND company_id = p_company;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_observed_zcajs_outbound_atomic(
  p_company_id uuid,
  p_external_conversation_id text,
  p_provider_msg_id text,
  p_sanitized_content text,
  p_raw_content text DEFAULT '',
  p_source_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  p_timestamp timestamptz DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_conversation public.conversations%ROWTYPE;
  v_existing public.interactions%ROWTYPE;
  v_customer_id uuid;
  v_interaction_id uuid;
  v_existing_delivery public.outbound_deliveries%ROWTYPE;
  v_external_ref text;
  v_peer_id text;
  v_msg_id text;
  v_event_time timestamptz := coalesce(p_timestamp, clock_timestamp());
  v_now timestamptz := clock_timestamp();
BEGIN
  IF p_company_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ZCAJS_COMPANY_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  v_peer_id := nullif(btrim(p_external_conversation_id), '');
  v_msg_id := nullif(btrim(p_provider_msg_id), '');
  IF v_peer_id IS NULL OR v_msg_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ZCAJS_PEER_AND_MESSAGE_ID_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    hashtextextended(p_company_id::text || ':zcajs-observed:' || v_msg_id, 0)
  );

  -- If CRM itself sent this provider message, the canonical interaction already owns it.
  SELECT * INTO v_existing_delivery
  FROM public.outbound_deliveries d
  WHERE d.company_id = p_company_id
    AND d.channel = 'ZALO'
    AND d.provider_message_id = v_msg_id
  ORDER BY d.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_existing_delivery.id IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'conversation_id', v_existing_delivery.conversation_id,
      'interaction_id', v_existing_delivery.interaction_id,
      'customer_id', NULL,
      'is_duplicate', true,
      'origin', 'CRM_DISPATCH'
    );
  END IF;

  v_external_ref := 'zcajs:self:' || v_msg_id;

  SELECT * INTO v_existing
  FROM public.interactions i
  WHERE i.company_id = p_company_id
    AND i.channel = 'ZALO'
    AND i.external_ref = v_external_ref
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_existing.id IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'conversation_id', v_existing.conversation_id,
      'interaction_id', v_existing.id,
      'customer_id', v_existing.customer_id,
      'is_duplicate', true,
      'origin', 'OBSERVED_ZALO'
    );
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_conversation
  FROM public.conversations c
  WHERE c.company_id = p_company_id
    AND c.channel = 'ZALO'
    AND c.external_conversation_id = v_peer_id

      company_id,

    ) VALUES (

    )

      company_id,
      customer_id,
      channel,
      external_conversation_id,
      last_message_at,
      unread_count,
      status,
      metadata,
      created_at,
      updated_at
    ) VALUES (

      v_customer_id,
      'ZALO',
      v_peer_id,

        'external_user_id', v_peer_id
      ),
      v_now,
      v_now
    )
    RETURNING * INTO v_conversation;
  ELSE

  END IF;

    'ZALO',
    'MESSAGE',
    'OUTBOUND',
    coalesce(p_sanitized_content, ''),
    'SUCCEEDED',
    v_now,
    'v1',
    v_external_ref,
    'SALE',
    NULL,
    v_event_time
  );

  INSERT INTO private.interaction_raw_contents (
    interaction_id,
    company_id,
    raw_content,
    raw_payload,
    source_metadata,
    created_at
  ) VALUES (
    v_interaction_id,
    p_company_id,
    coalesce(p_raw_content, ''),
    coalesce(p_source_metadata, '{}'::jsonb),
    coalesce(p_source_metadata, '{}'::jsonb),
    v_event_time
  );

  UPDATE public.conversations
  SET last_message_at = greatest(coalesce(last_message_at, v_event_time), v_event_time),
      status = 'OPEN',
      updated_at = v_now
  WHERE id = v_conversation.id
    AND company_id = p_company_id;

    'interaction_id', v_interaction_id,
    'customer_id', v_customer_id,
    'is_duplicate', false,

END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.zalo_device_heartbeat(
  p_device uuid,
  p_key_hash text,
  p_agent_version text,
  p_agent_status text,
  p_zalo_running boolean,
  p_permissions_ok boolean,
  p_permissions_detail jsonb,
  p_loopback_ready boolean,
  p_error_code text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
DECLARE
  d public.zalo_recording_devices;
  v_status text;
BEGIN
  -- Authenticate device with HMAC hash
  SELECT * INTO d FROM public.zalo_recording_devices
  WHERE id = p_device AND active AND device_key_hash = p_key_hash FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.companies WHERE id = d.company_id AND status = 'ACTIVE') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ZALO_DEVICE_UNAUTHORIZED' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;

  -- Validate/derive status:
  -- Degraded if missing permissions or loopback is not ready
  IF NOT p_permissions_ok OR NOT p_loopback_ready THEN
    v_status := 'DEGRADED';
  ELSE
    v_status := CASE WHEN p_agent_status IN ('ONLINE', 'DEGRADED') THEN p_agent_status ELSE 'ONLINE' END;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.zalo_recording_devices
  SET
    last_seen_at = now(),
    agent_version = nullif(btrim(p_agent_version), ''),
    agent_status = v_status,
    zalo_running = coalesce(p_zalo_running, false),
    permissions_ok = coalesce(p_permissions_ok, false),
    permissions_detail = coalesce(p_permissions_detail, '{}'::jsonb),
    loopback_ready = coalesce(p_loopback_ready, false),
    last_error_code = nullif(btrim(p_error_code), ''),
    last_error_at = CASE WHEN nullif(btrim(p_error_code), '') IS NOT NULL THEN now() ELSE last_error_at END
  WHERE id = d.id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'status', v_status,
    'device_id', d.id,
    'company_id', d.company_id,
    'last_seen_at', now()
  );
END $$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.zalo_get_devices_readiness(
  p_company uuid,
  p_actor uuid
)
RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role text;
  v_devices jsonb;
BEGIN
  v_role := public.zalo_assert_actor(p_company, p_actor);

  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'id', d.id,
      'device_name', d.device_name,
      'staff_user_id', d.staff_user_id,
      'is_current_staff', (d.staff_user_id = p_actor),
      'active', d.active,
      'agent_version', d.agent_version,
      'raw_status', d.agent_status,
      'computed_status', CASE
        WHEN NOT d.active THEN 'OFFLINE'
        WHEN d.last_seen_at IS NULL OR d.last_seen_at < (now() - interval '2 minutes') THEN 'OFFLINE'
        WHEN NOT d.permissions_ok OR NOT d.loopback_ready OR d.agent_status = 'DEGRADED' THEN 'DEGRADED'
        ELSE 'ONLINE'
      END,
      'zalo_running', d.zalo_running,
      'permissions_ok', d.permissions_ok,
      'permissions_detail', d.permissions_detail,
      'loopback_ready', d.loopback_ready,
      'last_error_code', d.last_error_code,
      'last_error_at', d.last_error_at,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_outbound_interaction_atomic(
  p_company_id uuid,
  p_conversation_id uuid,
  p_customer_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,
  p_channel text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_sanitized_content text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_raw_content text DEFAULT '',
  p_sanitization_status text DEFAULT 'SUCCEEDED',
  p_source_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  p_client_command_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,
  p_actor_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_conversation public.conversations%ROWTYPE;
  v_customer_id uuid;
  v_customer_name text := NULL;
  v_channel text;
  v_interaction_id uuid;
  v_delivery_id uuid;
  v_delivery_status text;
  v_existing_fingerprint text;
  v_fingerprint text;
  v_sanitization_status text;
  v_provider text;
  v_now timestamptz := clock_timestamp();
BEGIN
  -- 1. Validate mandatory fields
  IF p_company_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'p_company_id là bắt buộc'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023', HINT = 'MISSING_COMPANY_ID';
  END IF;
  IF p_conversation_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'p_conversation_id là bắt buộc'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023', HINT = 'MISSING_CONVERSATION_ID';
  END IF;

  -- 2. Authenticated Actor Attribution Validation
  IF p_actor_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.company_members cm
      JOIN public.user_profiles up ON up.id = cm.user_id
      JOIN public.companies c ON c.id = cm.company_id
      WHERE cm.company_id = p_company_id
        AND cm.user_id = p_actor_user_id
        AND cm.status = 'ACTIVE'
        AND up.status = 'ACTIVE'
        AND c.status = 'ACTIVE'
        AND cm.role IN ('SALE', 'BOSS_ADMIN', 'ADMIN', 'BOSS')
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'ACTOR_NOT_AUTHORIZED: Người dùng không có quyền gửi tin nhắn hoặc không thuộc tổ chức này.'
        USING ERRCODE = '42501', HINT = 'ACTOR_NOT_AUTHORIZED';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 3. Lock conversation
  SELECT * INTO v_conversation
  FROM public.conversations
  WHERE id = p_conversation_id
    AND company_id = p_company_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND: Cuộc hội thoại không tồn tại hoặc không thuộc quyền quản lý của tổ chức.'
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0002', HINT = 'CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND';
  END IF;

  v_customer_id := coalesce(p_customer_id, v_conversation.customer_id);

  -- Resolve canonical customer name from public.customers scoped by company_id
  IF v_customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT c.name INTO v_customer_name
    FROM public.customers c
    WHERE c.id = v_customer_id
      AND c.company_id = p_company_id;
  END IF;

  v_channel := coalesce(nullif(upper(trim(p_channel)), ''), v_conversation.channel);
  v_channel := CASE
    WHEN v_channel IN ('FACEBOOK', 'ZALO', 'SYSTEM', 'HOTLINE', 'DIRECT') THEN v_channel
    WHEN upper(trim(v_channel)) = 'FB' THEN 'FACEBOOK'
    WHEN upper(trim(v_channel)) = 'ZL' THEN 'ZALO'
    ELSE 'DIRECT'
  END;

  v_sanitization_status := CASE
    WHEN upper(trim(coalesce(p_sanitization_status, 'SUCCEEDED'))) IN ('CLEAN', 'SANITIZED', 'SUCCEEDED') THEN 'SUCCEEDED'
    WHEN upper(trim(coalesce(p_sanitization_status, 'SUCCEEDED'))) = 'PENDING' THEN 'PENDING'
    WHEN upper(trim(coalesce(p_sanitization_status, 'SUCCEEDED'))) = 'FAILED' THEN 'FAILED'
    WHEN upper(trim(coalesce(p_sanitization_status, 'SUCCEEDED'))) = 'NOT_REQUIRED' THEN 'NOT_REQUIRED'
    ELSE 'SUCCEEDED'
  END;

  v_fingerprint := encode(
    sha256(
      convert_to(
        p_company_id::text || ':' ||
        p_conversation_id::text || ':' ||
        coalesce(v_customer_id::text, '') || ':' ||
        v_channel || ':' ||
        trim(coalesce(p_sanitized_content, '')),
        'UTF8'
      )
    ),
    'hex'
  );

  -- 4. Idempotency Check
  IF p_client_command_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
      hashtextextended(p_company_id::text || ':outbound_cmd:' || p_client_command_id::text, 0)
    );

    SELECT o.interaction_id, o.id, o.delivery_status, o.request_fingerprint
    INTO v_interaction_id, v_delivery_id, v_delivery_status, v_existing_fingerprint
    FROM public.outbound_deliveries o
    WHERE o.company_id = p_company_id
      AND o.client_command_id = p_client_command_id;

    IF FOUND THEN
      IF v_existing_fingerprint IS NOT NULL AND v_existing_fingerprint <> v_fingerprint THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED_WITH_DIFFERENT_PAYLOAD: Lệnh gửi đã được sử dụng với nội dung khác.'
          USING ERRCODE = 'P0001', HINT = 'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED_WITH_DIFFERENT_PAYLOAD';
      END IF;

      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'interaction_id', v_interaction_id,
        'conversation_id', p_conversation_id,
        'customer_id', v_customer_id,
        'channel', v_channel,
        'delivery_id', v_delivery_id,
        'delivery_status', coalesce(v_delivery_status, 'PENDING_DISPATCH'),
        'is_duplicate', true
      );
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 5. Extract provider from conversation metadata
  v_provider := coalesce(v_conversation.metadata->>'provider', 'default');

  v_interaction_id := gen_random_uuid();

  -- Chèn outbound_deliveries
  INSERT INTO public.outbound_deliveries (
    company_id,
    conversation_id,
    interaction_id,
    channel,
    provider,
    content,
    delivery_status,
    status,
    client_command_id,
    idempotency_key,
    request_fingerprint,
    metadata
  ) VALUES (
    p_company_id,
    p_conversation_id,
    v_interaction_id,
    v_channel,
    v_provider,
    coalesce(p_raw_content, p_sanitized_content, ''),
    'PENDING_DISPATCH',
    'PENDING',
    p_client_command_id,
    coalesce(p_client_command_id::text, gen_random_uuid()::text),
    v_fingerprint,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'page_id', v_conversation.metadata->>'page_id',
      'page_name', v_conversation.metadata->>'page_name',
      'customer_fb_id', v_conversation.metadata->>'customer_fb_id',
      'external_conversation_id', v_conversation.metadata->>'external_conversation_id',
      'customer_name', v_customer_name
    )
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_delivery_id;

  -- 6. Ghi nhận interaction
  INSERT INTO public.interactions (
    id,
    company_id,
    customer_id,
    conversation_id,
    channel,
    type,
    direction,
    sanitized_content,
    sanitization_status,
    sanitized_at,
    sanitizer_version,
    actor_type,
    actor_user_id,
    created_at
  ) VALUES (
    v_interaction_id,
    p_company_id,
    v_customer_id,
    p_conversation_id,
    v_channel,
    'MESSAGE',
    'OUTBOUND',
    p_sanitized_content,
    v_sanitization_status,
    v_now,
    'v1',
    'SALE',
    p_actor_user_id,
    v_now
  );

  -- 7. Ghi nhận raw content
  INSERT INTO private.interaction_raw_contents (
    interaction_id,
    company_id,
    raw_content,
    raw_payload,
    source_metadata,
    created_at
  ) VALUES (
    v_interaction_id,
    p_company_id,
    coalesce(p_raw_content, ''),
    coalesce(p_source_metadata, '{}'::jsonb),
    coalesce(p_source_metadata, '{}'::jsonb),
    v_now
  );

  -- 8. Cập nhật conversations
  UPDATE public.conversations
  SET last_message_at = v_now,
      updated_at = v_now
  WHERE id = p_conversation_id
    AND company_id = p_company_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'interaction_id', v_interaction_id,
    'conversation_id', p_conversation_id,
    'customer_id', v_customer_id,
    'channel', v_channel,
    'delivery_id', v_delivery_id,
    'delivery_status', 'PENDING_DISPATCH',
    'status', 'PENDING',
    'is_duplicate', false
  );
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.zalo_get_devices_readiness(
  p_company uuid,
  p_actor uuid
)
RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role text;
  v_devices jsonb;
BEGIN
  v_role := public.zalo_assert_actor(p_company, p_actor);

  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'id', d.id,
      'device_name', d.device_name,
      'staff_user_id', d.staff_user_id,
      'is_current_staff', (d.staff_user_id = p_actor),
      'active', d.active,
      'agent_version', d.agent_version,
      'raw_status', d.agent_status,
      'computed_status', CASE
        WHEN NOT d.active THEN 'OFFLINE'
        WHEN d.last_seen_at IS NULL OR d.last_seen_at < (now() - interval '2 minutes') THEN 'OFFLINE'
        WHEN NOT d.permissions_ok OR NOT d.loopback_ready OR d.agent_status = 'DEGRADED' THEN 'DEGRADED'
        ELSE 'ONLINE'
      END,
      'zalo_running', d.zalo_running,
      'permissions_ok', d.permissions_ok,
      'permissions_detail', d.permissions_detail,
      'loopback_ready', d.loopback_ready,
      'last_error_code', d.last_error_code,
      'last_error_at', d.last_error_at,
      'last_seen_at', d.last_seen_at,
      'created_at', d.created_at
    ) ORDER BY
      (d.staff_user_id IS NOT NULL AND d.staff_user_id = p_actor) DESC,
      (d.last_seen_at >= now() - interval '2 minutes' AND d.agent_status = 'ONLINE') DESC,
      d.last_seen_at DESC NULLS LAST,
      d.created_at DESC
  ), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_devices
  FROM public.zalo_recording_devices d
  WHERE d.company_id = p_company
    AND d.active
    AND (v_role = 'BOSS_ADMIN' OR d.staff_user_id = p_actor OR d.staff_user_id IS NULL);

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'devices', v_devices
  );
END $$;

  UPDATE public.zalo_call_transcriptions zct
  SET status = 'PENDING',
      lock_token = NULL,
      locked_by = NULL,
      locked_at = NULL,
      lease_expires_at = NULL,
      attempts = zct.attempts + 1,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE zct.status = 'PROCESSING'
    AND zct.lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL
    AND zct.lease_expires_at < now();

  -- 2. Claim available jobs with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT zct.id, zct.call_id, zct.company_id
    FROM public.zalo_call_transcriptions zct
    WHERE zct.status = 'PENDING'
      AND zct.next_run_at <= now()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.zalo_complete_transcription(
  p_company uuid,
  p_transcription_id uuid,
  p_lock_token uuid,
  p_full_transcript text,
  p_utterances jsonb,
  p_channels_silent jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  p_language text DEFAULT 'vi'
)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql

SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_tx public.zalo_call_transcriptions;
  v_elem jsonb;
  v_seq integer;
  v_speaker text;
  v_channel text;
  v_start integer;
  v_end integer;
  v_text text;
  v_conf double precision;
  v_seg_id text;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_tx
  FROM public.zalo_call_transcriptions
  WHERE id = p_transcription_id
    AND company_id = p_company
    AND lock_token = p_lock_token
    AND status = 'PROCESSING'
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'TRANSCRIPTION_LOCK_LOST';
  END IF;

  -- Insert utterances
  IF p_utterances IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(p_utterances) = 'array' THEN
    FOR v_elem IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_utterances)
    LOOP
      v_seq := (v_elem->>'sequence')::integer;
      v_speaker := v_elem->>'speaker_role';
      v_channel := v_elem->>'channel';
      v_start := (v_elem->>'start_ms')::integer;
      v_end := (v_elem->>'end_ms')::integer;
      v_text := v_elem->>'text';
      v_conf := (v_elem->>'confidence')::double precision;
      v_seg_id := v_elem->>'provider_segment_id';

      IF v_seq IS NOT NULL AND v_speaker IN ('STAFF', 'CUSTOMER') AND v_channel IN ('LEFT', 'RIGHT')
         AND v_start >= 0 AND v_end >= v_start AND v_text IS NOT NULL THEN
        INSERT INTO public.zalo_call_transcript_utterances (
          company_id,
          transcription_id,
          call_id,
          sequence,
          speaker_role,
          channel,
          start_ms,
          end_ms,
          text,
          confidence,
          provider_segment_id
        )
        VALUES (
          p_company,
          v_tx.id,
          v_tx.call_id,
          v_seq,
          v_speaker,
          v_channel,
          v_start,
          v_end,
          v_text,
          v_conf,
          v_seg_id
        )
        ON CONFLICT (transcription_id, sequence) DO UPDATE
          SET speaker_role = EXCLUDED.speaker_role,
              channel = EXCLUDED.channel,
              start_ms = EXCLUDED.start_ms,
              end_ms = EXCLUDED.end_ms,
              text = EXCLUDED.text,
              confidence = EXCLUDED.confidence;
      END IF;
    END LOOP;
  END IF;

  -- Update transcription status to COMPLETED
  UPDATE public.zalo_call_transcriptions
  SET status = 'COMPLETED',
      completed_at = now(),
      full_transcript = p_full_transcript,
      channels_silent = COALESCE(p_channels_silent, '{}'::jsonb),
      language = COALESCE(p_language, language),
      lock_token = NULL,
      locked_by = NULL,
      locked_at = NULL,
      lease_expires_at = NULL,
      error_code = NULL,
      error_message = NULL,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = v_tx.id;

  -- Update call transcript_status to COMPLETED
  UPDATE public.zalo_personal_calls
  SET transcript_status = 'COMPLETED'
  WHERE id = v_tx.call_id AND company_id = p_company;

  -- Audit log
  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(company_id, user_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, customer_id, result, metadata)
  VALUES (
    p_company,
    NULL,
    'ZALO_TRANSCRIPTION_COMPLETED',
    'ZALO_CALL',
    v_tx.call_id,
    v_tx.customer_id,
    'SUCCESS',

      'transcription_id', v_tx.id,
      'provider', v_tx.provider,
      'language', COALESCE(p_language, v_tx.language)
    )
  );

  RETURN true;
END;

      customer_id,

        next_run_at = now(),
        error_code = NULL,
        error_message = NULL,
        lock_token = NULL,
        locked_by = NULL,
        locked_at = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL,
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = v_tx.id;

  SET transcript_status = 'PENDING'

  -- Audit log for retry

  VALUES (

    p_actor,
    'ZALO_TRANSCRIPTION_RETRY',
    'ZALO_CALL',
    p_call,
    v_call.customer_id,
    'SUCCESS',
    jsonb_build_object('transcription_id', v_tx.id)
  );

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.zalo_claim_transcription_job(
  p_company uuid,
  p_transcription_id uuid,
  p_locked_by text DEFAULT 'zalo_transcription_worker',
  p_lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 300
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  id uuid,
  company_id uuid,
  call_id uuid,
  customer_id uuid,
  provider text,
  language text,
  raw_channel_layout text,
  attempts integer,
  max_attempts integer,
  lock_token uuid,
  recording_path text,
  audio_validation jsonb
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE
  v_lease_duration interval;
  v_job record;
  v_new_attempts integer;
  v_new_lock_token uuid;
BEGIN
  -- Strict validation: both company and transcription_id must be provided
  IF p_company IS NULL OR p_transcription_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  v_lease_duration := (GREATEST(COALESCE(p_lease_seconds, 300), 30) || ' seconds')::interval;

  -- 1. Acquire targeted row FIRST using SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.
  -- Includes company match, call recording READY status, and valid non-empty recording_path.
  -- If another connection holds a row lock on this target row (PENDING or PROCESSING),
  -- SKIP LOCKED returns zero rows promptly without blocking or statement timeouts.
  SELECT
    zct.id,
    zct.company_id,
    zct.call_id,
    zct.customer_id,
    zct.provider,
    zct.language,
    zct.raw_channel_layout,
    zct.status,
    zct.attempts,
    zct.max_attempts,
    zct.next_run_at,
    zct.lease_expires_at,
    zct.started_at,
    zpc.recording_path,
    zpc.audio_validation
  INTO v_job
  FROM public.zalo_call_transcriptions zct
  JOIN public.zalo_personal_calls zpc
    ON zpc.id = zct.call_id AND zpc.company_id = zct.company_id
  WHERE zct.id = p_transcription_id
    AND zct.company_id = p_company
    AND zpc.recording_status = 'READY'
    AND zpc.recording_path IS NOT NULL
    AND btrim(zpc.recording_path) <> ''
  FOR UPDATE OF zct SKIP LOCKED;

  -- If not selected (locked, wrong tenant, non-ready call, empty path, missing record)
  IF v_job.id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- 2. Process only the acquired locked row based on its current status
  IF v_job.status = 'PENDING' THEN
    -- Check eligibility: must be due and not already exhausted
    IF v_job.next_run_at > now() OR v_job.attempts >= v_job.max_attempts THEN
      RETURN;
    END IF;

    v_new_lock_token := gen_random_uuid();

    UPDATE public.zalo_call_transcriptions zct
    SET status = 'PROCESSING',
        lock_token = v_new_lock_token,
        locked_by = COALESCE(p_locked_by, 'zalo_transcription_worker'),
        locked_at = now(),
        started_at = COALESCE(zct.started_at, now()),
        lease_expires_at = now() + v_lease_duration,
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE zct.id = v_job.id AND zct.company_id = v_job.company_id;

    UPDATE public.zalo_personal_calls zpc
    SET transcript_status = 'PROCESSING'
    WHERE zpc.id = v_job.call_id AND zpc.company_id = v_job.company_id;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
      v_job.id,
      v_job.company_id,
      v_job.call_id,
      v_job.customer_id,
      v_job.provider,
      v_job.language,
      v_job.raw_channel_layout,
      v_job.attempts,
      v_job.max_attempts,
      v_new_lock_token AS lock_token,
      v_job.recording_path,
      v_job.audio_validation;
    RETURN;

  ELSIF v_job.status = 'PROCESSING' THEN
    -- Check if lease has expired
    IF v_job.lease_expires_at IS NULL OR v_job.lease_expires_at >= now() THEN
      -- Active lease held by another worker: cannot reclaim or claim
      RETURN;
    END IF;

    -- Expired lease: bound attempts to [0, 10] check constraint and max_attempts
    v_new_attempts := LEAST(v_job.attempts + 1, 10);

    IF v_new_attempts >= v_job.max_attempts THEN
      -- Exhausted attempts: fail closed to terminal FAILED state
      UPDATE public.zalo_call_transcriptions zct
      SET status = 'FAILED',
          completed_at = now(),
          error_code = 'EXPIRED_LEASE_MAX_ATTEMPTS',
          error_message = 'Lease expired and max attempts reached',
          lock_token = NULL,
          locked_by = NULL,
          locked_at = NULL,
          lease_expires_at = NULL,
          attempts = v_new_attempts,
          updated_at = now()
      WHERE zct.id = v_job.id AND zct.company_id = v_job.company_id;

      UPDATE public.zalo_personal_calls zpc
      SET transcript_status = 'FAILED'
      WHERE zpc.id = v_job.call_id AND zpc.company_id = v_job.company_id;

      -- Returns zero claimed
      RETURN;
    ELSE
      -- Reclaim and claim in one safe atomic operation with fresh token
      v_new_lock_token := gen_random_uuid();

      UPDATE public.zalo_call_transcriptions zct
      SET status = 'PROCESSING',
          lock_token = v_new_lock_token,
          locked_by = COALESCE(p_locked_by, 'zalo_transcription_worker'),
          locked_at = now(),
          started_at = COALESCE(zct.started_at, now()),
          lease_expires_at = now() + v_lease_duration,
          attempts = v_new_attempts,
          updated_at = now()
      WHERE zct.id = v_job.id AND zct.company_id = v_job.company_id;

      UPDATE public.zalo_personal_calls zpc
      SET transcript_status = 'PROCESSING'
      WHERE zpc.id = v_job.call_id AND zpc.company_id = v_job.company_id;

      RETURN QUERY
      SELECT
        v_job.id,

    SELECT zct.id, zct.company_id

    SET status = 'PROCESSING',

    WHERE zpc.id = v_job.call_id AND zpc.company_id = v_job.company_id;

          locked_by = NULL,
          locked_at = NULL,

      WHERE zcas.id = v_job.id AND zcas.company_id = v_job.company_id;

        'channel', u.channel,
        'start_ms', u.start_ms,
        'end_ms', u.end_ms,

    AND u.company_id = v_job.company_id;

    v_job.id,
    v_job.company_id,
    v_job.call_id,
    v_job.transcription_id,
    v_job.provider,
    v_job.model,
    v_job.prompt_version,
    COALESCE(v_new_attempts, v_job.attempts),
    v_job.max_attempts,
    v_new_lock_token,
    v_job.full_transcript,
    v_utterances;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gemini_pool_claim_key(
  p_exclude uuid[] DEFAULT '{}'::uuid[]
)
RETURNS TABLE(key_id uuid, ciphertext text, iv text, auth_tag text)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_id uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT k.id
  INTO v_id
  FROM public.gemini_api_key_pool k
  WHERE k.enabled = true
    AND (k.cooldown_until IS NULL OR k.cooldown_until <= now())
    AND NOT (k.id = ANY(COALESCE(p_exclude, '{}'::uuid[])))
  ORDER BY k.last_used_at ASC NULLS FIRST, k.created_at ASC
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.gemini_api_key_pool
  SET last_used_at = now(), updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = v_id;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT k.id, k.ciphertext, k.iv, k.auth_tag
  FROM public.gemini_api_key_pool k
  WHERE k.id = v_id;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gemini_pool_mark_result(
  p_key_id uuid,
  p_result text,
  p_error_code text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_cooldown_seconds integer DEFAULT 75
)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF p_result NOT IN ('SUCCESS', 'RATE_LIMITED', 'AUTH_ERROR', 'ERROR') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_ARGUMENTS';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.gemini_api_key_pool
  SET
    last_success_at = CASE WHEN p_result = 'SUCCESS' THEN now() ELSE last_success_at END,
    last_error_code = CASE WHEN p_result = 'SUCCESS' THEN NULL ELSE left(COALESCE(p_error_code, p_result), 100) END,
    consecutive_rate_limits = CASE
      WHEN p_result = 'SUCCESS' THEN 0
      WHEN p_result = 'RATE_LIMITED' THEN consecutive_rate_limits + 1
      ELSE consecutive_rate_limits
    END,
    cooldown_until = CASE
      WHEN p_result = 'SUCCESS' THEN NULL
      WHEN p_result = 'RATE_LIMITED' THEN now() + make_interval(secs => LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_cooldown_seconds, 75), 60), 600))
      WHEN p_result = 'AUTH_ERROR' THEN now() + interval '1 hour'
      ELSE cooldown_until
    END,
    enabled = CASE WHEN p_result = 'AUTH_ERROR' THEN false ELSE enabled END,
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = p_key_id;

  RETURN FOUND;
END;
$$;

  p_company uuid,
  p_transcription_id uuid,
  p_lock_token uuid,
  p_channel text,
  p_segments jsonb,

)

END;

    SET priority = CASE
          WHEN EXCLUDED.priority = 'URGENT' THEN 'URGENT'
          WHEN ai_handover_cases.priority = 'URGENT' THEN 'URGENT'
          WHEN EXCLUDED.priority = 'HIGH' THEN 'HIGH'

)

BEGIN

    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_REQUEST';
  END IF;

  -- Find existing ACTIVE alert with the same fingerprint
  SELECT id, public.ai_monitoring_alerts.trigger_count
  INTO v_existing_id, v_existing_count
  FROM public.ai_monitoring_alerts
  WHERE company_id = p_company_id

        metadata = p_metadata,
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = v_existing_id;

    RETURN QUERY SELECT v_existing_id, true, v_existing_count + 1;
  ELSE
    -- Insert new active alert
    INSERT INTO public.ai_monitoring_alerts (
      company_id,
      alert_type,
      severity,
      status,
      fingerprint,
      title,
      description,
      channel,
      metadata,
      first_triggered_at,
      last_triggered_at,
      trigger_count
    ) VALUES (

      p_alert_type,
      p_severity,
      'ACTIVE',
      p_fingerprint,
      p_title,
      p_description,
      p_channel,
      p_metadata,
      now(),
      now(),
      1
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_new_id;

    RETURN QUERY SELECT v_new_id, false, 1;
  END IF;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_ai_brain_live_deliveries(
  p_limit integer,
  p_lock_token uuid,
  p_channel text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  id uuid,
  company_id uuid,
  customer_id uuid,
  conversation_id uuid,
  source_interaction_id uuid,
  channel text,
  attempts integer
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF p_lock_token IS NULL OR p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit < 1 OR p_limit > 10 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_REQUEST';
  END IF;

  IF p_channel IS NOT NULL AND p_channel NOT IN ('ZALO', 'MESSENGER', 'VOICE') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CHANNEL';
  END IF;

  WITH expired_final AS (
    SELECT d.id
    FROM public.ai_brain_live_deliveries d
    WHERE d.send_status = 'PROCESSING'
      AND d.locked_at < now() - interval '5 minutes'
      AND d.attempts >= 5
      AND (p_channel IS NULL OR d.channel = p_channel)
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  )
  UPDATE public.ai_brain_live_deliveries d
  SET send_status = 'FAILED',
      error_code = 'BRAIN_TIMEOUT',
      completed_at = now(),
      locked_at = NULL,
      lock_token = NULL,
      updated_at = now()
  FROM expired_final ef
  WHERE d.id = ef.id;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT d.id
    FROM public.ai_brain_live_deliveries d
    WHERE (
      (
        d.send_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')
        AND d.available_at <= now()
        AND d.attempts < 5
        AND (p_channel IS NULL OR d.channel = p_channel)
      )
      OR (
        d.send_status = 'PROCESSING'
        AND d.locked_at < now() - interval '5 minutes'
        AND d.attempts < 5
        AND (p_channel IS NULL OR d.channel = p_channel)
      )
    )
    ORDER BY d.available_at, d.created_at
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    LIMIT p_limit
  ), claimed AS (
    UPDATE public.ai_brain_live_deliveries d
    SET send_status = 'PROCESSING',
        attempts = d.attempts + 1,
        locked_at = now(),
        lock_token = p_lock_token,
        completed_at = NULL,
        updated_at = now()
    FROM candidates c
    WHERE d.id = c.id
    RETURNING d.id, d.company_id, d.customer_id, d.conversation_id,
              d.source_interaction_id, d.channel, d.attempts
  )
  SELECT * FROM claimed;
END;
$$;

     OR p_delivery_id IS NULL
     OR p_external_ref IS NULL
     OR p_content IS NULL
     OR length(trim(p_content)) = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_INPUT';
  END IF;

  SELECT i.id INTO v_interaction_id
  FROM public.interactions i
  WHERE i.company_id = p_company_id
    AND i.channel = 'FACEBOOK'
    AND i.external_ref = p_external_ref
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_interaction_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN v_interaction_id;
  END IF;

  -- Insert OUTBOUND interaction for timeline
  INSERT INTO public.interactions (
    company_id,
    customer_id,
    conversation_id,
    channel,
    type,
    direction,
    sanitized_content,
    sanitization_status,
    sanitized_at,
    sanitizer_version,
    external_ref,
    actor_type,
    actor_user_id,
    created_at

    p_company_id,
    p_customer_id,
    p_conversation_id,
    'FACEBOOK',
    'MESSAGE',
    'OUTBOUND',
    p_content,
    'SUCCEEDED',
    v_now,
    'ai-messenger-live-v1',
    p_external_ref,
    coalesce(p_actor_type, 'AI'),
    NULL,
    v_now
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_interaction_id;

  -- Insert raw payload for auditability
  INSERT INTO private.interaction_raw_contents (
    interaction_id,
    company_id,
    raw_content,
    raw_payload,
    source_metadata
  ) VALUES (
    v_interaction_id,
    p_company_id,
    p_content,
    jsonb_build_object('external_ref', p_external_ref),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'source', 'ai_messenger_live_delivery',
      'delivery_id', p_delivery_id,
      'source_interaction_id', p_source_interaction_id,
      'actor_type', coalesce(p_actor_type, 'AI')
    )
  );

  -- Update conversation activity timestamp and status
  UPDATE public.conversations c
  SET last_message_at = greatest(c.last_message_at, v_now),

  WHERE c.id = p_conversation_id

  SET state = 'AI_RESPONDED',
      ai_response_interaction_id = v_interaction_id,
      updated_at = v_now
  WHERE company_id = p_company_id
    AND conversation_id = p_conversation_id
    AND state = 'OPEN';

  RETURN v_interaction_id;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_ai_brain_live_deliveries(
  p_limit integer,
  p_lock_token uuid,
  p_channel text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  id uuid,
  company_id uuid,
  customer_id uuid,
  conversation_id uuid,
  source_interaction_id uuid,
  channel text,
  attempts integer
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF p_lock_token IS NULL OR p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit < 1 OR p_limit > 10 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_REQUEST';
  END IF;

  IF p_channel IS NOT NULL AND p_channel NOT IN ('ZALO', 'MESSENGER', 'VOICE') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CHANNEL';
  END IF;

  -- Stale processing sweep: mark expired rows as FAILED.
  -- If dispatch_started_at is set, it is an UNCERTAIN crash failure and must never be retried.
  WITH expired_final AS (
    SELECT d.id, d.dispatch_started_at
    FROM public.ai_brain_live_deliveries d
    WHERE d.send_status = 'PROCESSING'
      AND d.locked_at < now() - interval '5 minutes'
      AND (d.attempts >= 5 OR d.dispatch_started_at IS NOT NULL)
      AND (p_channel IS NULL OR d.channel = p_channel)
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  )
  UPDATE public.ai_brain_live_deliveries d
  SET send_status = 'FAILED',
      error_code = CASE
        WHEN ef.dispatch_started_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'MESSENGER_DISPATCH_UNCERTAIN'
        ELSE 'BRAIN_TIMEOUT'
      END,
      completed_at = now(),
      locked_at = NULL,
      lock_token = NULL,
      updated_at = now()
  FROM expired_final ef
  WHERE d.id = ef.id;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT d.id
    FROM public.ai_brain_live_deliveries d
    WHERE (
      (
        d.send_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')
        AND d.available_at <= now()
        AND d.attempts < 5
        AND d.dispatch_started_at IS NULL
        AND (
          d.error_code IS NULL
          OR d.error_code NOT IN (
            'MESSENGER_DISPATCH_UNCERTAIN',
            'OUTBOUND_PERSISTENCE_FAILED',
            'CANARY_NOT_ALLOWED',
            'CANARY_RESTRICTED',
            'MESSAGING_WINDOW_CLOSED',
            'PAGE_COMPANY_MISMATCH',
            'PAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED',
            'EMPTY_DRAFT',
            'LIVE_SCOPE_INVALID',
            'LIVE_SOURCE_INVALID'
          )
        )
        AND (p_channel IS NULL OR d.channel = p_channel)
      )
      OR (
        d.send_status = 'PROCESSING'
        AND d.locked_at < now() - interval '5 minutes'
        AND d.attempts < 5
        AND d.dispatch_started_at IS NULL
        AND (
          d.error_code IS NULL
          OR d.error_code NOT IN (
            'MESSENGER_DISPATCH_UNCERTAIN',
            'OUTBOUND_PERSISTENCE_FAILED',
            'CANARY_NOT_ALLOWED',
            'CANARY_RESTRICTED',
            'MESSAGING_WINDOW_CLOSED',
            'PAGE_COMPANY_MISMATCH',
            'PAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED',
            'EMPTY_DRAFT',
            'LIVE_SCOPE_INVALID',
            'LIVE_SOURCE_INVALID'
          )
        )
        AND (p_channel IS NULL OR d.channel = p_channel)
      )
    )
    ORDER BY d.available_at, d.created_at
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    LIMIT p_limit
  ), claimed AS (
    UPDATE public.ai_brain_live_deliveries d
    SET send_status = 'PROCESSING',
        attempts = d.attempts + 1,
        locked_at = now(),
        lock_token = p_lock_token,
        completed_at = NULL,
        updated_at = now()
    FROM candidates c
    WHERE d.id = c.id
    RETURNING d.id, d.company_id, d.customer_id, d.conversation_id,
              d.source_interaction_id, d.channel, d.attempts
  )
  SELECT * FROM claimed;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finish_ai_brain_live_delivery_extended(
  p_id uuid,
  p_lock_token uuid,
  p_send_status text,
  p_decision text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_confidence numeric DEFAULT NULL,
  p_external_message_id text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_error_code text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_brain_turn_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,
  p_brain_latency_ms integer DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_rows_updated integer;
  v_now timestamptz := now();
  v_attempts integer;
  v_backoff_seconds integer;
  v_is_non_retryable boolean := false;
  v_raw_mid text;
BEGIN
  IF p_id IS NULL OR p_lock_token IS NULL OR p_send_status IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_REQUEST';
  END IF;
  IF p_send_status NOT IN ('SENT', 'SKIPPED', 'FAILED') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_STATUS';
  END IF;

  -- Extract raw provider MID if passed in meta:Page:MID format
  IF p_external_message_id IS NOT NULL AND p_external_message_id ~ '^meta:[0-9]+:(.+)$' THEN
    v_raw_mid := substring(p_external_message_id from '^meta:[0-9]+:(.+)$');
  ELSE
    v_raw_mid := p_external_message_id;
  END IF;

  IF p_error_code IN (
    'MESSENGER_DISPATCH_UNCERTAIN',
    'OUTBOUND_PERSISTENCE_FAILED',
    'CANARY_NOT_ALLOWED',
    'CANARY_RESTRICTED',
    'MESSAGING_WINDOW_CLOSED',
    'PAGE_COMPANY_MISMATCH',
    'PAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED',
    'EMPTY_DRAFT',
    'LIVE_SCOPE_INVALID',
    'LIVE_SOURCE_INVALID'
  ) THEN
    v_is_non_retryable := true;
  END IF;

  IF p_send_status = 'FAILED' THEN
    SELECT d.attempts INTO v_attempts
    FROM public.ai_brain_live_deliveries d
    WHERE d.id = p_id
      AND d.lock_token = p_lock_token
      AND d.send_status = 'PROCESSING'
      AND d.locked_at > v_now - interval '5 minutes';

    IF v_attempts IS NULL THEN
      RETURN false;
    END IF;

    IF v_is_non_retryable THEN
      -- Terminal non-retryable failure: preserve real attempts count.
      -- claim_ai_brain_live_deliveries excludes non-retryable error_code and marked rows.
      UPDATE public.ai_brain_live_deliveries d
      SET send_status = 'FAILED',
          decision = p_decision,
          confidence = p_confidence,
          external_message_id = COALESCE(v_raw_mid, d.external_message_id),
          error_code = p_error_code,
          brain_turn_id = p_brain_turn_id,
          brain_latency_ms = COALESCE(p_brain_latency_ms, d.brain_latency_ms),
          completed_at = v_now,
          locked_at = NULL,
          lock_token = NULL,
          updated_at = v_now
      WHERE d.id = p_id
        AND d.lock_token = p_lock_token
        AND d.send_status = 'PROCESSING'
        AND d.locked_at > v_now - interval '5 minutes';
    ELSE
      v_backoff_seconds := LEAST(300, 30 * GREATEST(1, v_attempts));

      UPDATE public.ai_brain_live_deliveries d
      SET send_status = 'FAILED',
          decision = p_decision,
          confidence = p_confidence,
          external_message_id = COALESCE(v_raw_mid, d.external_message_id),
          error_code = p_error_code,
          brain_turn_id = p_brain_turn_id,
          brain_latency_ms = COALESCE(p_brain_latency_ms, d.brain_latency_ms),
          available_at = v_now + (v_backoff_seconds * interval '1 second'),
          completed_at = v_now,
          locked_at = NULL,
          lock_token = NULL,
          updated_at = v_now
      WHERE d.id = p_id
        AND d.lock_token = p_lock_token
        AND d.send_status = 'PROCESSING'
        AND d.locked_at > v_now - interval '5 minutes';
    END IF;

    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows_updated = ROW_COUNT;
    RETURN v_rows_updated = 1;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.ai_brain_live_deliveries d
  SET send_status = p_send_status,
      decision = p_decision,
      confidence = p_confidence,
      external_message_id = COALESCE(v_raw_mid, d.external_message_id),
      error_code = p_error_code,
      brain_turn_id = p_brain_turn_id,
      brain_latency_ms = COALESCE(p_brain_latency_ms, d.brain_latency_ms),
      completed_at = v_now,
      sent_at = CASE WHEN p_send_status = 'SENT' THEN v_now ELSE NULL END,
      locked_at = NULL,
      lock_token = NULL,
      updated_at = v_now
  WHERE d.id = p_id
    AND d.lock_token = p_lock_token
    AND d.send_status = 'PROCESSING'
    AND d.locked_at > v_now - interval '5 minutes';

  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows_updated = ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN v_rows_updated = 1;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_ai_messenger_live_outbound(
  p_company_id uuid,
  p_customer_id uuid,
  p_conversation_id uuid,
  p_source_interaction_id uuid,
  p_delivery_id uuid,
  p_external_ref text,
  p_content text,
  p_actor_type text DEFAULT 'AI'
)
RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_delivery record;
  v_conv record;
  v_bound_interaction record;
  v_candidate record;
  v_existing_interaction_id uuid;
  v_interaction_id uuid;
  v_raw_mid text;
  v_page_id text;
  v_expected_page_id text;
  v_now timestamptz := clock_timestamp();
BEGIN
  -- 1. Input validation & actor requirement
  IF p_company_id IS NULL
     OR p_customer_id IS NULL
     OR p_conversation_id IS NULL
     OR p_source_interaction_id IS NULL
     OR p_delivery_id IS NULL
     OR p_external_ref IS NULL
     OR p_content IS NULL
     OR length(trim(p_content)) = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_INPUT';
  END IF;

  -- Require p_actor_type AI
  IF p_actor_type IS NOT NULL AND p_actor_type <> 'AI' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_ACTOR_TYPE';
  END IF;

  -- 2. Validate external_ref format: accept ONLY canonical meta:Page:MID.
  -- Do not accept raw ref fallback; existing transport already sends canonical refs.
  -- Require nonempty raw MID.
  IF p_external_ref !~ '^meta:[0-9]+:(.+)$' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_EXTERNAL_REF_FORMAT';
  END IF;

  v_page_id := split_part(p_external_ref, ':', 2);
  v_raw_mid := substring(p_external_ref from '^meta:[0-9]+:(.+)$');

  IF v_raw_mid IS NULL OR btrim(v_raw_mid) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'EMPTY_RAW_MID';
  END IF;

  -- 3. Lock delivery row for update first (serializes concurrent calls on the same delivery)
  SELECT d.id, d.company_id, d.customer_id, d.conversation_id, d.source_interaction_id,
         d.channel, d.send_status, d.dispatch_started_at, d.external_message_id,
         d.outbound_interaction_id
  INTO v_delivery
  FROM public.ai_brain_live_deliveries d
  WHERE d.id = p_delivery_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'DELIVERY_NOT_FOUND';
  END IF;

  -- Validate delivery scope
  IF v_delivery.company_id <> p_company_id
     OR v_delivery.customer_id <> p_customer_id
     OR v_delivery.conversation_id <> p_conversation_id
     OR v_delivery.source_interaction_id <> p_source_interaction_id
     OR v_delivery.channel <> 'MESSENGER' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'DELIVERY_SCOPE_MISMATCH';
  END IF;

  -- First persistence must require durable authorized dispatch_started_at.
  -- Reject PENDING / unmarked deliveries!
  IF v_delivery.dispatch_started_at IS NULL OR v_delivery.send_status = 'PENDING' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'DISPATCH_NOT_AUTHORIZED';
  END IF;

  -- Enforce provider message ID consistency:
  -- If delivery already has external_message_id recorded, refuse a different raw MID or ref
  IF v_delivery.external_message_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF v_delivery.external_message_id <> v_raw_mid AND v_delivery.external_message_id <> p_external_ref THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'DELIVERY_ALREADY_BOUND_TO_DIFFERENT_REF';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 4. Lock and validate conversation row & enforce Page equal to exact bound conversation Page
  SELECT c.id, c.company_id, c.customer_id, c.channel, c.status, c.external_conversation_id
  INTO v_conv
  FROM public.conversations c
  WHERE c.id = p_conversation_id
    AND c.company_id = p_company_id
    AND c.customer_id = p_customer_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND';
  END IF;

  IF v_conv.channel <> 'FACEBOOK'
     OR v_conv.external_conversation_id IS NULL
     OR v_conv.external_conversation_id !~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+$' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONVERSATION_INVALID';
  END IF;

  v_expected_page_id := split_part(v_conv.external_conversation_id, ':', 1);

  -- Same raw MID under a different Page must fail:
  IF v_page_id <> v_expected_page_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PAGE_MISMATCH';
  END IF;

  -- 5. If delivery already has outbound_interaction_id bound, validate it and return (idempotent before/after finish)
  IF v_delivery.outbound_interaction_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT i.id, i.company_id, i.customer_id, i.conversation_id, i.channel,
           i.type, i.direction, i.actor_type, i.external_ref
    INTO v_bound_interaction
    FROM public.interactions i
    WHERE i.id = v_delivery.outbound_interaction_id;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOUND_INTERACTION_NOT_FOUND';
    END IF;

    -- Validate existing/bound interaction company, customer, conversation, FACEBOOK channel,
    -- MESSAGE type, OUTBOUND direction, AI actor, and canonical external_ref before reusing it.
    -- Reject conflicting reference or scope; never reuse an unrelated same-company interaction.
    IF v_bound_interaction.company_id <> p_company_id
       OR v_bound_interaction.customer_id <> p_customer_id
       OR v_bound_interaction.conversation_id <> p_conversation_id
       OR v_bound_interaction.channel <> 'FACEBOOK'
       OR v_bound_interaction.type <> 'MESSAGE'
       OR v_bound_interaction.direction <> 'OUTBOUND'
       OR v_bound_interaction.actor_type <> 'AI'
       OR v_bound_interaction.external_ref <> p_external_ref THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOUND_INTERACTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH';
    END IF;

    RETURN v_bound_interaction.id;
  END IF;

  -- 6. Check existing interactions for this external_ref or matching raw MID across the company
  -- Validate scope and canonical ref before reusing. Reject conflicting reference or scope.
  v_existing_interaction_id := NULL;
  FOR v_candidate IN
    SELECT i.id, i.company_id, i.customer_id, i.conversation_id, i.channel,
           i.type, i.direction, i.actor_type, i.external_ref
    FROM public.interactions i
    WHERE i.company_id = p_company_id
      AND (
        i.external_ref = p_external_ref
        OR i.external_ref LIKE 'meta:%:' || v_raw_mid
        OR i.external_ref = v_raw_mid
      )
  LOOP
    -- Must strictly match canonical external_ref AND exact conversation/customer/direction/actor/channel/type
    IF v_candidate.external_ref <> p_external_ref
       OR v_candidate.customer_id <> p_customer_id
       OR v_candidate.conversation_id <> p_conversation_id
       OR v_candidate.channel <> 'FACEBOOK'
       OR v_candidate.type <> 'MESSAGE'
       OR v_candidate.direction <> 'OUTBOUND'
       OR v_candidate.actor_type <> 'AI' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'INTERACTION_CONFLICT';
    END IF;
    v_existing_interaction_id := v_candidate.id;
  END LOOP;

  IF v_existing_interaction_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    -- Reuse matching interaction and bind to delivery
    UPDATE public.ai_brain_live_deliveries
    SET external_message_id = COALESCE(external_message_id, v_raw_mid),
        outbound_interaction_id = v_existing_interaction_id,
        updated_at = v_now
    WHERE id = p_delivery_id;

    RETURN v_existing_interaction_id;
  END IF;

  -- 7. Insert OUTBOUND interaction for timeline
  INSERT INTO public.interactions (
    company_id,
    customer_id,
    conversation_id,
    channel,
    type,
    direction,
    sanitized_content,
    sanitization_status,
    sanitized_at,
    sanitizer_version,
    external_ref,
    actor_type,
    actor_user_id,
    created_at
  ) VALUES (
    p_company_id,
    p_customer_id,
    p_conversation_id,
    'FACEBOOK',
    'MESSAGE',
    'OUTBOUND',
    p_content,

    v_now,

    p_external_ref,

    NULL,

    )

CREATE FUNCTION public.c360_request_refresh(p_company_id uuid,p_customer_id uuid) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
BEGIN

    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOT_FOUND'; END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.customer_dossier_refresh(company_id,customer_id,due_at,last_manual_at)
    VALUES(p_company_id,p_customer_id,clock_timestamp(),clock_timestamp())

    requested_version=CASE WHEN customer_dossier_refresh.requested_version=customer_dossier_refresh.completed_version

    due_at=least(customer_dossier_refresh.due_at,clock_timestamp()),attempts=0,
    last_manual_at=clock_timestamp()

CREATE FUNCTION public.c360_list(p_company_id uuid,p_search text DEFAULT '',p_page integer DEFAULT 1,
  p_owner uuid DEFAULT NULL,p_channel text DEFAULT NULL,p_stage text DEFAULT NULL,p_hot boolean DEFAULT false,
  p_overdue boolean DEFAULT false,p_recent boolean DEFAULT false,p_sort text DEFAULT 'updated',p_include_ai boolean DEFAULT false)
RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
DECLARE result jsonb; BEGIN
  IF p_page NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 OR length(p_search)>200 OR p_sort NOT IN ('updated','name','contact','score','followup')
    OR (p_channel IS NOT NULL AND p_channel NOT IN ('ZALO','FACEBOOK','PHONE','EMAIL')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_FILTER'; END IF;
  WITH rows AS (
    SELECT c.id,c.customer_code,c.name,c.stage,c.source,c.updated_at,
      p.address,p.birth_year,p.special_notes,coalesce(p.assigned_sale_id,owner.assigned_to) AS assigned_sale_id,u.full_name AS assigned_sale,
      ids.zalo_name,ids.facebook_name,ids.channels,em.email,
      CASE WHEN ph.normalized_phone IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE left(ph.normalized_phone,4)||'******'||right(ph.normalized_phone,2) END AS phone,
      s.snapshot->'currentSituation'->>'text' AS current_situation,s.lead_score,s.follow_up_at,s.generated_at AS ai_updated_at,
      greatest(msg.at,zc.at) AS last_interaction,
      count(*) OVER() AS total
    FROM public.customers c
    LEFT JOIN public.customer_dossier_profiles p ON p.company_id=c.company_id AND p.customer_id=c.id
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT assigned_to FROM public.conversations conv WHERE conv.company_id=c.company_id
      AND conv.customer_id=c.id AND conv.assigned_to IS NOT NULL ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id LIMIT 1) owner ON true
    LEFT JOIN public.user_profiles u ON u.id=coalesce(p.assigned_sale_id,owner.assigned_to)
    LEFT JOIN private.customer_private_contacts ph ON ph.company_id=c.company_id AND ph.customer_id=c.id
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT v.normalized_value AS email FROM private.customer_identity_values v
      WHERE v.company_id=c.company_id AND v.customer_id=c.id ORDER BY v.identity_id LIMIT 1) em ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT max(coalesce(i.display_name,i.metadata->>'display_name')) FILTER(WHERE channel='ZALO') AS zalo_name,
      max(coalesce(i.display_name,i.metadata->>'display_name')) FILTER(WHERE channel='FACEBOOK') AS facebook_name,
      array_agg(DISTINCT channel) AS channels FROM public.identities i WHERE i.company_id=c.company_id AND i.customer_id=c.id) ids ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT a.snapshot,a.lead_score,a.follow_up_at,a.generated_at FROM public.customer_ai_snapshots a
      WHERE p_include_ai AND a.company_id=c.company_id AND a.customer_id=c.id ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT max(created_at) AS at FROM public.interactions i WHERE i.company_id=c.company_id AND i.customer_id=c.id) msg ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT max(started_at) AS at FROM public.zalo_personal_calls z WHERE z.company_id=c.company_id AND z.customer_id=c.id) zc ON true
    WHERE c.company_id=p_company_id
      AND (p_search='' OR c.name ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%' OR ph.normalized_phone ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%'
        OR em.email ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.identities si
          WHERE si.company_id=c.company_id AND si.customer_id=c.id AND si.channel IN ('ZALO','FACEBOOK')
            AND (si.display_name ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%' OR si.metadata->>'display_name' ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%')))
      AND (p_owner IS NULL OR coalesce(p.assigned_sale_id,owner.assigned_to)=p_owner)
      AND (p_channel IS NULL OR p_channel=ANY(ids.channels))
      AND (p_stage IS NULL OR c.stage=p_stage)
      AND (NOT p_hot OR s.lead_score>=70)
      AND (NOT p_overdue OR s.follow_up_at<now())
      AND (NOT p_recent OR greatest(msg.at,zc.at)>now()-interval '7 days')
  ), page AS (
    SELECT * FROM rows ORDER BY
      CASE WHEN p_sort='name' THEN name END ASC,
      CASE WHEN p_sort='contact' THEN last_interaction END DESC NULLS LAST,
      CASE WHEN p_sort='score' THEN lead_score END DESC NULLS LAST,
      CASE WHEN p_sort='followup' THEN follow_up_at END ASC NULLS LAST,
      CASE WHEN p_sort='updated' THEN updated_at END DESC,id
    LIMIT 25 OFFSET (p_page-1)*25
  ) SELECT jsonb_build_object('items',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(page)-'total') FROM page),'[]'::jsonb),
    'total',coalesce((SELECT max(total) FROM rows),0),'page',p_page,'pageSize',25) INTO result;
  RETURN result;
END $$;
