CREATE FUNCTION public.c360_timeline(p_company_id uuid,p_customer_id uuid,p_page integer DEFAULT 1,
  p_filter text DEFAULT 'ALL',p_staff_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,p_include_ai boolean DEFAULT false)
RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
DECLARE result jsonb; BEGIN
  IF p_page NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 OR p_filter NOT IN ('ALL','MESSAGE','CALL','NOTE','AI','EVENT')
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_FILTER'; END IF;
  WITH events AS (
    SELECT 'interaction:'||i.id AS id,CASE i.type WHEN 'MESSAGE' THEN 'MESSAGE' WHEN 'NOTE' THEN 'NOTE'
      WHEN 'CALL_EVENT' THEN 'CALL' ELSE 'EVENT' END AS kind,i.channel,i.direction,
      i.created_at AS at,i.sanitized_content AS content,i.id AS source_id
      FROM public.interactions i WHERE i.company_id=p_company_id AND i.customer_id=p_customer_id
        AND i.sanitization_status IN ('SUCCEEDED','NOT_REQUIRED')
        AND NOT(i.type='CALL_EVENT' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.zalo_personal_calls z
          WHERE z.company_id=i.company_id AND z.customer_id=i.customer_id AND i.external_ref=z.id::text)
          OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.calls c WHERE c.company_id=i.company_id AND c.customer_id=i.customer_id AND i.external_ref=c.id::text)))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'recording:'||z.id,'CALL',z.channel,z.direction,z.started_at,
      concat('Cuộc gọi Zalo · ',round(z.duration_seconds)::text,' giây · ',z.recording_status),z.id
      FROM public.zalo_personal_calls z WHERE z.company_id=p_company_id AND z.customer_id=p_customer_id
        AND (p_staff_id IS NULL OR z.staff_user_id=p_staff_id)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'call:'||c.id,'CALL',c.provider,c.direction,c.started_at,'Cuộc gọi · '||c.status,c.id
      FROM public.calls c WHERE p_include_ai AND c.company_id=p_company_id AND c.customer_id=p_customer_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'appointment:'||a.id,'EVENT','CRM',NULL,a.start_time,'Lịch hẹn · '||a.status,a.id
      FROM public.appointments a WHERE a.company_id=p_company_id AND a.customer_id=p_customer_id
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.interactions i WHERE i.company_id=a.company_id AND i.customer_id=a.customer_id AND i.external_ref=a.id::text)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'snapshot:'||s.id,'AI','AI',NULL,s.generated_at,s.snapshot->'summary'->>'text',s.id
      FROM public.customer_ai_snapshots s WHERE p_include_ai AND s.company_id=p_company_id AND s.customer_id=p_customer_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'stage:'||h.id,'EVENT','CRM',NULL,h.changed_at,h.from_stage||' → '||h.to_stage,h.id
      FROM public.customer_stage_histories h WHERE h.company_id=p_company_id AND h.customer_id=p_customer_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'handover:'||h.id,'EVENT','CRM',NULL,h.created_at,'Chuyển giao cho sale: '||h.reason,h.id
      FROM public.ai_handover_cases h WHERE h.company_id=p_company_id AND h.customer_id=p_customer_id
  ), filtered AS(SELECT * FROM events WHERE p_filter='ALL' OR kind=p_filter), page AS(
    SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 30 OFFSET (p_page-1)*30
  ) SELECT jsonb_build_object('items',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(page) ORDER BY at DESC,id DESC) FROM page),'[]'::jsonb),
    'total',(SELECT count(*) FROM filtered),'page',p_page,'pageSize',30) INTO result;
  RETURN result;
END $$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.campaign_claim(p_company uuid,p_channel text) RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
DECLARE
  c public.messaging_campaigns;
  r public.messaging_campaign_recipients;
BEGIN
  IF p_channel <> 'ZALO_PERSONAL' THEN
    RETURN public.campaign_claim_before_personal(p_company,p_channel);
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM public.messaging_campaign_settings
     WHERE company_id=p_company AND enabled
  ) THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;

  -- Serialize personal-Zalo claims for the company. This prevents concurrent worker
  -- polls from racing around the sender-wide five-minute cadence.
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    hashtextextended(p_company::text || ':campaign:zalo_personal:claim', 0)
  );

  SELECT * INTO c
    FROM public.messaging_campaigns ca
   WHERE ca.company_id=p_company
     AND ca.channel='ZALO_PERSONAL'
     AND ca.status IN ('RUNNING','SCHEDULED','PAUSED','CANCELLED')
     AND ca.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
     AND coalesce(ca.scheduled_at,ca.created_at)<=clock_timestamp()
     AND EXISTS(
       SELECT 1
         FROM public.messaging_campaign_recipients q
        WHERE q.campaign_id=ca.id
          AND (
            (ca.status IN ('RUNNING','SCHEDULED') AND (
              (q.delivery_status='QUEUED' AND q.next_attempt_at<=clock_timestamp()) OR
              (q.delivery_status='CLAIMED' AND q.lease_until<clock_timestamp())
            )) OR
            (q.delivery_status='SENDING' AND q.lease_until<clock_timestamp())
          )
     )
   ORDER BY ca.created_at,ca.id
   FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
   LIMIT 1;

  IF c.id IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;

  WITH expired AS (
    UPDATE public.messaging_campaign_recipients
       SET delivery_status='UNCERTAIN',
           provider_error_code='LEASE_EXPIRED_AFTER_DISPATCH',
           provider_error_message_sanitized='Provider outcome unknown; reconciliation required.',
           lock_token=NULL,
           lease_until=NULL,
           updated_at=clock_timestamp()
     WHERE campaign_id=c.id
       AND delivery_status='SENDING'
       AND lease_until<clock_timestamp()
     RETURNING *
  )
  INSERT INTO public.messaging_campaign_audit(company_id,campaign_id,event,metadata)
  SELECT company_id,campaign_id,'recipient_failed',
         jsonb_build_object('recipient_id',id,'code','LEASE_EXPIRED_AFTER_DISPATCH')
    FROM expired;

  IF c.status IN ('PAUSED','CANCELLED') THEN
    PERFORM public.campaign_recount(c.id);
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;

  -- Hard sender-wide pacing. Even when the worker was offline and several scheduled
  -- recipients are overdue, a second dispatch cannot begin until five minutes after
  -- the previous dispatch attempt on the same personal Zalo sender.
  IF EXISTS(
    SELECT 1
      FROM public.messaging_campaign_recipients prev
      JOIN public.messaging_campaigns pc ON pc.id=prev.campaign_id
     WHERE pc.company_id=p_company
       AND pc.channel='ZALO_PERSONAL'
       AND pc.sender_account_id=c.sender_account_id
       AND prev.dispatch_started_at IS NOT NULL
       AND prev.dispatch_started_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '5 minutes'
  ) THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO r
    FROM public.messaging_campaign_recipients
   WHERE campaign_id=c.id
     AND attempt_count<5
     AND (
       (delivery_status='QUEUED' AND next_attempt_at<=clock_timestamp()) OR
       (delivery_status='CLAIMED' AND lease_until<clock_timestamp())
     )
   ORDER BY next_attempt_at,created_at,id
   FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
   LIMIT 1;

  IF r.id IS NULL THEN
    PERFORM public.campaign_recount(c.id);
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.messaging_campaign_recipients
     SET delivery_status='CLAIMED',
         lock_token=gen_random_uuid(),
         lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds',
         updated_at=clock_timestamp()
   WHERE id=r.id
   RETURNING * INTO r;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'id',r.id,
    'company_id',r.company_id,
    'campaign_id',c.id,
    'lock_token',r.lock_token,
    'channel',c.channel
  );
END $$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.campaign_sync_senders(
  p_company uuid,
  p_actor uuid,
  p_pages jsonb
) RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path='' AS $$
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.campaign_sync_senders_before_personal(p_company,p_actor,p_pages);

  INSERT INTO public.messaging_sender_accounts(
    company_id,channel,external_id,name,connected,verified
  )
  SELECT p_company,'ZALO_PERSONAL',oa_id,'Zalo cá nhân',true,true
    FROM public.zalo_oa_configs
   WHERE company_id=p_company
     AND status='ACTIVE'
     AND app_id='ZCAJS'
     AND oa_id LIKE 'zcajs:%'
   ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST
   LIMIT 1
  ON CONFLICT(channel,external_id) DO UPDATE
    SET name='Zalo cá nhân',connected=true,verified=true
    WHERE public.messaging_sender_accounts.company_id=p_company;

  -- ZCAJS ingress stores its authoritative peer id on the conversation rather than
  -- on identities.metadata. Materialize that observed peer id into the canonical
  -- identities table so the existing campaign FK/fencing model remains intact.
  INSERT INTO public.identities(
    company_id,customer_id,channel,external_id,verified,metadata
  )
  SELECT
    conv.company_id,
    conv.customer_id,
    'ZALO',
    conv.external_conversation_id,
    false,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'source','ZCAJS',
      'provider','zcajs',
      'materialized_from','conversation'
    )
  FROM public.conversations conv
  WHERE conv.company_id=p_company
    AND conv.channel='ZALO'
    AND conv.customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND conv.external_conversation_id ~ '^[0-9]+$'
    AND lower(coalesce(conv.metadata->>'provider',''))='zcajs'
  ON CONFLICT(company_id,channel,external_id) DO UPDATE
    SET metadata=public.identities.metadata || EXCLUDED.metadata,
        updated_at=clock_timestamp()
    WHERE public.identities.customer_id=EXCLUDED.customer_id;
END $$;

      AND i.customer_id = d.customer_id AND i.conversation_id = d.conversation_id

    WHERE d.id = p_id AND d.lock_token = p_lock_token AND d.send_status = 'PROCESSING'
      AND d.locked_at > now() - interval '5 minutes' AND d.channel = 'ZALO'
      AND s.enabled AND c.channel = 'ZALO' AND c.ai_mode = 'ACTIVE'
      AND c.assigned_to IS NULL AND c.status NOT IN ('CLOSED','PENDING_SALE')

      AND i.created_at + interval '5 minutes' <= now()

          AND reply.conversation_id = d.conversation_id AND reply.customer_id = d.customer_id
          AND reply.type = 'MESSAGE' AND reply.direction = 'OUTBOUND'
          AND reply.actor_type IN ('SALE','TECHNICIAN','AI') AND reply.created_at >= i.created_at
      )
  );

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_ai_brain_live_deliveries(p_limit integer, p_lock_token uuid, p_channel text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, company_id uuid, customer_id uuid, conversation_id uuid, source_interaction_id uuid, channel text, attempts integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_lock_token IS NULL OR p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit < 1 OR p_limit > 10 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_REQUEST';
  END IF;

  IF p_channel IS NOT NULL AND p_channel NOT IN ('ZALO', 'MESSENGER', 'VOICE') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_CHANNEL';
  END IF;

  -- Stale processing sweep: mark expired rows as FAILED.
  -- If dispatch_started_at is set, it is an UNCERTAIN crash failure and must never be retried.
  WITH expired_final AS (
    SELECT d.id, to_jsonb(d)->>'dispatch_started_at' AS dispatch_started_at
    FROM public.ai_brain_live_deliveries d
    WHERE d.send_status = 'PROCESSING'
      AND d.locked_at < now() - interval '5 minutes'
      AND (d.attempts >= 5 OR (to_jsonb(d)->>'dispatch_started_at') IS NOT NULL)
      AND (p_channel IS NULL OR d.channel = p_channel)
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  )
  UPDATE public.ai_brain_live_deliveries d
  SET send_status = 'FAILED',
      error_code = CASE
        WHEN ef.dispatch_started_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'MESSENGER_DISPATCH_UNCERTAIN'
        ELSE 'BRAIN_TIMEOUT'
      END,
      completed_at = now(),
      locked_at = NULL,
      lock_token = NULL,
      updated_at = now()
  FROM expired_final ef
  WHERE d.id = ef.id;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT d.id
    FROM public.ai_brain_live_deliveries d
    WHERE (
      (
        d.send_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')
        AND d.retryable
        AND d.available_at <= now()
        AND (d.channel <> 'ZALO' OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.interactions i WHERE i.id = d.source_interaction_id
          AND i.company_id = d.company_id AND i.conversation_id = d.conversation_id
          AND i.created_at + interval '5 minutes' <= now()
        ))
        AND d.attempts < 5
        AND (to_jsonb(d)->>'dispatch_started_at') IS NULL
        AND (
          d.error_code IS NULL
          OR d.error_code NOT IN (
            'MESSENGER_DISPATCH_UNCERTAIN',
            'OUTBOUND_PERSISTENCE_FAILED',
            'CANARY_NOT_ALLOWED',
            'CANARY_RESTRICTED',
            'MESSAGING_WINDOW_CLOSED',
            'PAGE_COMPANY_MISMATCH',
            'PAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED',
            'EMPTY_DRAFT',
            'LIVE_SCOPE_INVALID',
            'LIVE_SOURCE_INVALID'
          )
        )
        AND (p_channel IS NULL OR d.channel = p_channel)
      )
      OR (
        d.retryable AND d.send_status = 'PROCESSING'
        AND d.locked_at < now() - interval '5 minutes'
        AND d.attempts < 5
        AND (to_jsonb(d)->>'dispatch_started_at') IS NULL
        AND (
          d.error_code IS NULL
          OR d.error_code NOT IN (
            'MESSENGER_DISPATCH_UNCERTAIN',
            'OUTBOUND_PERSISTENCE_FAILED',
            'CANARY_NOT_ALLOWED',
            'CANARY_RESTRICTED',
            'MESSAGING_WINDOW_CLOSED',
            'PAGE_COMPANY_MISMATCH',
            'PAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED',
            'EMPTY_DRAFT',
            'LIVE_SCOPE_INVALID',
            'LIVE_SOURCE_INVALID'
          )
        )
        AND (p_channel IS NULL OR d.channel = p_channel)
      )
    )
    ORDER BY d.available_at, d.created_at
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    LIMIT p_limit
  ), claimed AS (
    UPDATE public.ai_brain_live_deliveries d
    SET send_status = 'PROCESSING',
        attempts = d.attempts + 1,
        locked_at = now(),
        lock_token = p_lock_token,
        completed_at = NULL,
        updated_at = now()
    FROM candidates c
    WHERE d.id = c.id
    RETURNING d.id, d.company_id, d.customer_id, d.conversation_id,
              d.source_interaction_id, d.channel, d.attempts
  )
  SELECT * FROM claimed;
END;
$function$;

WITH exact_matches AS (
  SELECT pc.id, pc.company_id, (array_agg(c.id ORDER BY c.id))[1] AS customer_id
  FROM public.zalo_personal_calls pc
  JOIN public.customers c
    ON c.company_id = pc.company_id
   AND public.zalo_search_name(c.name) = public.zalo_search_name(pc.remote_display_name_normalized)
  WHERE pc.customer_id IS NULL
    AND pc.recording_status = 'READY'
    AND pc.remote_display_name_normalized <> ''
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.zalo_customer_identity_mappings m
      WHERE m.company_id = pc.company_id
        AND m.zalo_account_key = pc.zalo_account_key
        AND m.remote_display_name_normalized = pc.remote_display_name_normalized
        AND m.active
    )
  GROUP BY pc.id, pc.company_id
  HAVING count(*) = 1
), linked AS (
  UPDATE public.zalo_personal_calls pc
  SET customer_id = e.customer_id,
      matching_status = 'EXACT',
      identity_ambiguous = false,
      linked_by = NULL,
      linked_at = now()
  FROM exact_matches e
  WHERE pc.id = e.id
  RETURNING pc.company_id, pc.id, pc.customer_id
)
UPDATE public.zalo_call_transcriptions t
SET customer_id = l.customer_id, updated_at = now()
FROM linked l
WHERE t.company_id = l.company_id AND t.call_id = l.id
  AND t.status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING');

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.han_ingest_outbound(
    p_company uuid,
    p_channel text,
    p_page text,
    p_customer_psid text,
    p_key text,
    p_content text,
    p_safe text,
    p_safe_status text,
    p_occurred timestamptz,
    p_payload jsonb
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_external text := p_page || ':' || p_customer_psid;
  v_customer uuid;
  v_conversation uuid;
  v_interaction uuid;
  v_mid text;
BEGIN
  -- 1. Strict validation
  IF p_channel IS NULL OR p_channel <> 'FACEBOOK'
    OR p_safe_status IS NULL OR p_safe_status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED')
    OR p_page IS NULL OR p_page !~ '^[0-9]+$'
    OR p_customer_psid IS NULL OR p_customer_psid !~ '^[0-9]+$'
    OR p_key IS NULL OR length(p_key) = 0
    OR p_content IS NULL
    OR length(p_key) > 500
    OR length(p_content) > 10000
    OR (p_safe_status = 'FAILED' AND p_safe IS NOT NULL)
    OR (p_safe_status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND p_safe IS NULL)
    OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.companies
      WHERE id = p_company AND status = 'ACTIVE'
    )
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_REQUEST';
  END IF;

  -- 2. Advisory lock for serialization on (company, key)
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    hashtextextended('han-outbound:' || p_company::text || ':' || p_key, 0)
  );

  -- 3. Idempotency check: interaction already recorded under this external_ref
  SELECT id INTO v_interaction
  FROM public.interactions
  WHERE company_id = p_company
    AND channel = 'FACEBOOK'
    AND external_ref = p_key;

  IF FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'status', 'PROCESSED',
      'interaction_id', v_interaction
    );
  END IF;

  -- 4. Reconciliation with CRM-originated sends:
  -- If this message was sent from CRM, private.han_outbox tracks it by provider_mid
  v_mid := CASE WHEN position(':' in p_key) > 0 THEN split_part(p_key, ':', 2) ELSE p_key END;

  SELECT interaction_id INTO v_interaction
  FROM private.han_outbox
  WHERE company_id = p_company
    AND provider_mid = v_mid;

  IF FOUND THEN
    UPDATE public.interactions
    SET external_ref = p_key
    WHERE id = v_interaction
      AND external_ref IS NULL;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'status', 'PROCESSED',
      'interaction_id', v_interaction
    );
  END IF;

  -- 5. Resolve Customer and Conversation
  SELECT customer_id INTO v_customer
  FROM public.identities
  WHERE company_id = p_company
    AND channel = 'FACEBOOK'
    AND external_id = v_external;

  IF v_customer IS NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.customers (
      company_id, name, source, stage
    ) VALUES (
      p_company, 'Khách Messenger', 'FACEBOOK', 'LEAD_NEW'
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_customer;

    INSERT INTO public.customer_stage_histories (
      company_id, customer_id, from_stage,
      to_stage, actor_type, reason
    ) VALUES (
      p_company, v_customer, NULL,
      'LEAD_NEW', 'SYSTEM', 'OMNICHANNEL_OUTBOUND'
    );

    INSERT INTO public.identities (
      company_id, customer_id, channel,
      external_id, verified
    ) VALUES (
      p_company, v_customer, 'FACEBOOK',
      v_external, false
    )
    ON CONFLICT (company_id, channel, external_id)
    DO NOTHING;
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.conversations (
    company_id, customer_id, channel,
    external_conversation_id,
    last_message_at, unread_count
  ) VALUES (
    p_company, v_customer, 'FACEBOOK',
    v_external, p_occurred, 0
  )
  ON CONFLICT (
    company_id, channel, external_conversation_id
  )
  DO UPDATE SET
    last_message_at = greatest(
      public.conversations.last_message_at,
      excluded.last_message_at
    )
    -- unread_count is NEVER incremented for outbound messages
  RETURNING id INTO v_conversation;

  -- 6. Insert OUTBOUND interaction
  INSERT INTO public.interactions (
    company_id, customer_id, conversation_id,
    channel, type, direction,
    sanitized_content, sanitization_status,
    sanitized_at, sanitizer_version,
    external_ref, actor_type, created_at
  ) VALUES (
    p_company, v_customer, v_conversation,
    'FACEBOOK', 'MESSAGE', 'OUTBOUND',
    p_safe, p_safe_status,
    CASE WHEN p_safe_status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN now() END,
    'han-bounded-v2',
    p_key, 'SALE', p_occurred
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_interaction;

  -- 7. Insert raw content into private schema
  INSERT INTO private.interaction_raw_contents (
    interaction_id, company_id, raw_content, raw_payload
  ) VALUES (
    v_interaction, p_company, p_content, p_payload
  );

  -- 8. Resolve active Response SLA window if open (SALE responded outside CRM)
  UPDATE public.response_sla_windows
  SET state = 'SALE_RESPONDED',
      sale_response_interaction_id = v_interaction,
      resolved_at = p_occurred,
      dispatch_state = 'PROVIDER_ACCEPTED',
      dispatch_fenced_until = NULL,
      ai_dispatch_fenced_until = NULL,
      ai_dispatch_token = NULL,
      updated_at = p_occurred
  WHERE conversation_id = v_conversation
    AND state = 'OPEN'
    AND started_at <= p_occurred;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'status', 'ACCEPTED',
    'interaction_id', v_interaction
  );
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.canonical_customer_stage(p_stage text)
RETURNS text
LANGUAGE sql
IMMUTABLE
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
  SELECT CASE pg_catalog.upper(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(p_stage, '')))
    -- Canonical six stages
    WHEN 'AWARENESS' THEN 'awareness'
    WHEN 'INTERESTED' THEN 'interested'
    WHEN 'DEEP_RESEARCH' THEN 'deep_research'
    WHEN 'LOW_POTENTIAL' THEN 'low_potential'
    WHEN 'HIGH_POTENTIAL' THEN 'high_potential'
    WHEN 'CONTRACT_SIGNED' THEN 'contract_signed'

    -- Legacy study-abroad stages
    WHEN 'LEAD_NEW' THEN 'awareness'
    WHEN 'CONTACT_CYCLE_1' THEN 'awareness'
    WHEN 'CONTACT_CYCLE_2' THEN 'awareness'
    WHEN 'CONTACT_CYCLE_3' THEN 'awareness'
    WHEN 'UNREACHABLE' THEN 'awareness'
    WHEN 'ZALO_FRIENDED' THEN 'awareness'
    WHEN 'IN_CARE' THEN 'interested'
    WHEN 'POTENTIAL_CLOSING' THEN 'high_potential'
    WHEN 'NOT_POTENTIAL' THEN 'low_potential'
    WHEN 'NO_DEMAND' THEN 'low_potential'
    WHEN 'CARE_NURTURING' THEN 'contract_signed'

    -- Legacy door/flood-barrier stages
    WHEN 'SURVEY_REQUESTED' THEN 'interested'
    WHEN 'SURVEY_SCHEDULED' THEN 'interested'
    WHEN 'SURVEY_COMPLETED' THEN 'interested'
    WHEN 'PRICE_CALCULATED' THEN 'high_potential'
    WHEN 'NEED_INFO' THEN 'interested'
    WHEN 'PRICE_OFFERED' THEN 'high_potential'
    WHEN 'NEGOTIATING' THEN 'high_potential'
    WHEN 'ORDER_CREATED' THEN 'high_potential'
    WHEN 'DEPOSIT_CONFIRMED' THEN 'high_potential'
    WHEN 'IN_PRODUCTION' THEN 'contract_signed'
    WHEN 'READY_FOR_INSTALL' THEN 'contract_signed'
    WHEN 'INSTALLING' THEN 'contract_signed'
    WHEN 'HANDOVER_COMPLETED' THEN 'contract_signed'
    WHEN 'WARRANTY_ACTIVE' THEN 'contract_signed'
    WHEN 'LOST' THEN 'low_potential'

    -- Vietnamese business aliases (defensive compatibility)
    WHEN 'KHACH_MOI' THEN 'awareness'
    WHEN 'LIEN_HE_LAN_1' THEN 'awareness'
    WHEN 'LIEN_HE_LAN_2' THEN 'awareness'
    WHEN 'LIEN_HE_LAN_3' THEN 'awareness'
    WHEN 'KHONG_NGHE_MAY' THEN 'awareness'
    WHEN 'DA_KET_BAN_ZALO' THEN 'awareness'
    WHEN 'DANG_CHAM_SOC' THEN 'interested'
    WHEN 'CO_TIEM_NANG' THEN 'high_potential'
    WHEN 'CHUA_TIEM_NANG' THEN 'low_potential'
    WHEN 'KHONG_NHU_CAU' THEN 'low_potential'
    WHEN 'DA_KY_HOP_DONG' THEN 'contract_signed'
    WHEN 'DA_KI_HOP_DONG' THEN 'contract_signed'
    WHEN 'CHAM_SOC_SAU_BAN' THEN 'contract_signed'
    WHEN 'DA_CO_GIA' THEN 'high_potential'
    WHEN 'DANG_THUONG_LUONG' THEN 'high_potential'

    ELSE NULL
  END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_customer_stage_counts(
  p_company_id uuid,
  p_from timestamptz DEFAULT NULL,
  p_to timestamptz DEFAULT NULL,
  p_source text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_search text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  stage text,
  customer_count bigint,
  needs_review_count bigint
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF p_company_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPANY_ID_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE = '22000';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
      c.id,
      c.stage,
      public.canonical_customer_stage(c.stage) AS canonical_stage
    FROM public.customers c
    WHERE c.company_id = p_company_id
      AND (p_from IS NULL OR c.created_at >= p_from)
      AND (p_to IS NULL OR c.created_at <= p_to)
      AND (p_source IS NULL OR c.source = p_source)
      AND (
        p_search IS NULL
        OR pg_catalog.btrim(p_search) = ''
        OR c.name ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%'
        OR c.customer_code ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%'
      )
  ),
  stage_order(stage_name, ord) AS (
    VALUES
      ('awareness', 1),
      ('interested', 2),
      ('deep_research', 3),
      ('low_potential', 4),
      ('high_potential', 5),
      ('contract_signed', 6)
  )
  SELECT
    so.stage_name,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM eligible e WHERE e.canonical_stage = so.stage_name),
    (SELECT count(*) FROM eligible e
      WHERE e.canonical_stage = so.stage_name
        AND e.stage <> e.canonical_stage)
  FROM stage_order so
  ORDER BY so.ord;

  -- Trả thêm dòng 'unmapped' nếu có dữ liệu không nhận diện được.
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.customers c
             WHERE c.company_id = p_company_id
               AND public.canonical_customer_stage(c.stage) IS NULL) THEN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
      'unmapped'::text,
      count(*)::bigint,
      count(*)::bigint
    FROM public.customers c
    WHERE c.company_id = p_company_id
      AND public.canonical_customer_stage(c.stage) IS NULL
      AND (p_from IS NULL OR c.created_at >= p_from)
      AND (p_to IS NULL OR c.created_at <= p_to)
      AND (p_source IS NULL OR c.source = p_source)
      AND (
        p_search IS NULL
        OR pg_catalog.btrim(p_search) = ''
        OR c.name ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%'
        OR c.customer_code ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%'
      );
  END IF;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_customer_stage_suggestions(
  p_company_id uuid,
  p_customer_id uuid,
  p_limit integer DEFAULT 10
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  id uuid,
  company_id uuid,
  customer_id uuid,
  summary text,
  stage_suggestion text,
  current_stage text,
  confidence numeric,
  evidence text,
  evidence_items jsonb,
  reason text,
  stop_reason text,
  objections jsonb,
  next_action text,
  requires_verification boolean,
  verification_status text,
  verified_by uuid,
  verified_at timestamptz,
  verification_note text,
  classifier_version text,
  model_version text,
  created_at timestamptz
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_customer_company_id uuid;
  v_limit integer;
BEGIN
  SELECT c.company_id INTO v_customer_company_id
  FROM public.customers c
  WHERE c.id = p_customer_id;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;
  IF v_customer_company_id <> p_company_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'TENANT_MISMATCH' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF p_limit IS NOT NULL AND (p_limit < 1 OR p_limit > 50) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_LIMIT' USING ERRCODE = '22000';
  END IF;
  v_limit := coalesce(p_limit, 10);

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    a.id,
    a.company_id,
    a.customer_id,
    a.summary,
    a.stage_suggestion,
    a.current_stage,
    a.confidence,
    a.evidence,
    coalesce(a.evidence_items, '[]'::jsonb),
    a.reason,
    a.stop_reason,
    a.objections,
    a.next_action,
    a.requires_verification,
    a.verification_status,
    a.verified_by,
    a.verified_at,
    a.verification_note,
    a.classifier_version,
    a.model_version,
    a.created_at
  FROM public.ai_analyses a
  WHERE a.company_id = p_company_id
    AND a.customer_id = p_customer_id
  ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
  LIMIT v_limit;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finish_ai_brain_live_delivery_extended(
  p_id uuid,
  p_lock_token uuid,
  p_send_status text,
  p_decision text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_confidence numeric DEFAULT NULL,
  p_external_message_id text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_error_code text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_brain_turn_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,
  p_brain_latency_ms integer DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_rows_updated integer;
  v_now timestamptz := now();
  v_attempts integer;
  v_backoff_seconds integer;
  v_is_non_retryable boolean := false;
  v_raw_mid text;
BEGIN
  IF p_id IS NULL OR p_lock_token IS NULL OR p_send_status IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_REQUEST';
  END IF;
  IF p_send_status NOT IN ('SENT', 'SKIPPED', 'FAILED') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_STATUS';
  END IF;

  -- Extract raw provider MID if passed in meta:Page:MID format
  IF p_external_message_id IS NOT NULL AND p_external_message_id ~ '^meta:[0-9]+:(.+)$' THEN
    v_raw_mid := substring(p_external_message_id from '^meta:[0-9]+:(.+)$');
  ELSE
    v_raw_mid := p_external_message_id;
  END IF;

  IF p_error_code IN (
    'MESSENGER_DISPATCH_UNCERTAIN',
    'OUTBOUND_PERSISTENCE_FAILED',
    'CANARY_NOT_ALLOWED',
    'CANARY_RESTRICTED',
    'MESSAGING_WINDOW_CLOSED',
    'PAGE_COMPANY_MISMATCH',
    'PAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED',
    'EMPTY_DRAFT',
    'LIVE_SCOPE_INVALID',
    'LIVE_SOURCE_INVALID'
  ) THEN
    v_is_non_retryable := true;
  END IF;

  IF p_send_status = 'FAILED' THEN
    SELECT d.attempts INTO v_attempts
    FROM public.ai_brain_live_deliveries d
    WHERE d.id = p_id
      AND d.lock_token = p_lock_token
      AND d.send_status = 'PROCESSING'
      AND d.locked_at > v_now - interval '5 minutes';

    IF v_attempts IS NULL THEN
      RETURN false;
    END IF;

    IF v_is_non_retryable THEN
      UPDATE public.ai_brain_live_deliveries d
      SET send_status = 'FAILED',
          decision = p_decision,
          confidence = p_confidence,
          external_message_id = COALESCE(v_raw_mid, d.external_message_id),
          error_code = p_error_code,
          brain_turn_id = p_brain_turn_id,
          brain_latency_ms = COALESCE(p_brain_latency_ms, d.brain_latency_ms),
          completed_at = v_now,
          locked_at = NULL,
          lock_token = NULL,
          updated_at = v_now
      WHERE d.id = p_id
        AND d.lock_token = p_lock_token
        AND d.send_status = 'PROCESSING'
        AND d.locked_at > v_now - interval '5 minutes';
    ELSE
      v_backoff_seconds := LEAST(300, 30 * GREATEST(1, v_attempts));

      UPDATE public.ai_brain_live_deliveries d
      SET send_status = 'FAILED',
          decision = p_decision,
          confidence = p_confidence,
          external_message_id = COALESCE(v_raw_mid, d.external_message_id),
          error_code = p_error_code,
          brain_turn_id = p_brain_turn_id,
          brain_latency_ms = COALESCE(p_brain_latency_ms, d.brain_latency_ms),
          available_at = v_now + (v_backoff_seconds * interval '1 second'),
          completed_at = v_now,
          locked_at = NULL,
          lock_token = NULL,
          updated_at = v_now
      WHERE d.id = p_id
        AND d.lock_token = p_lock_token
        AND d.send_status = 'PROCESSING'
        AND d.locked_at > v_now - interval '5 minutes';
    END IF;

    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows_updated = ROW_COUNT;
    RETURN v_rows_updated = 1;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.ai_brain_live_deliveries d
  SET send_status = p_send_status,
      decision = p_decision,
      confidence = p_confidence,
      external_message_id = COALESCE(v_raw_mid, d.external_message_id),
      error_code = p_error_code,
      brain_turn_id = p_brain_turn_id,
      brain_latency_ms = COALESCE(p_brain_latency_ms, d.brain_latency_ms),
      completed_at = v_now,
      sent_at = CASE WHEN p_send_status = 'SENT' THEN v_now ELSE NULL END,
      locked_at = NULL,
      lock_token = NULL,
      updated_at = v_now
  WHERE d.id = p_id
    AND d.lock_token = p_lock_token
    AND d.send_status = 'PROCESSING'
    AND d.locked_at > v_now - interval '5 minutes';

  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows_updated = ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN v_rows_updated = 1;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_ai_messenger_live_outbound(
  p_company_id uuid,
  p_customer_id uuid,
  p_conversation_id uuid,
  p_source_interaction_id uuid,
  p_delivery_id uuid,
  p_external_ref text,
  p_content text,
  p_actor_type text DEFAULT 'AI'
)
RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_delivery record;
  v_conv record;
  v_bound_interaction record;
  v_candidate record;
  v_existing_interaction_id uuid;
  v_interaction_id uuid;
  v_raw_mid text;
  v_page_id text;
  v_expected_page_id text;
  v_now timestamptz := clock_timestamp();
BEGIN
  -- 1. Input validation & actor requirement
  IF p_company_id IS NULL
     OR p_customer_id IS NULL
     OR p_conversation_id IS NULL
     OR p_source_interaction_id IS NULL
     OR p_delivery_id IS NULL
     OR p_external_ref IS NULL
     OR p_content IS NULL
     OR length(trim(p_content)) = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_INPUT';
  END IF;

  -- Require p_actor_type AI
  IF p_actor_type IS NOT NULL AND p_actor_type <> 'AI' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_ACTOR_TYPE';
  END IF;

  -- 2. Validate external_ref format: accept ONLY canonical meta:Page:MID.
  IF p_external_ref !~ '^meta:[0-9]+:(.+)$' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_EXTERNAL_REF_FORMAT';
  END IF;

  v_page_id := split_part(p_external_ref, ':', 2);
  v_raw_mid := substring(p_external_ref from '^meta:[0-9]+:(.+)$');

  IF v_raw_mid IS NULL OR btrim(v_raw_mid) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'EMPTY_RAW_MID';
  END IF;

  -- 3. Lock delivery row for update first (serializes concurrent calls on the same delivery)
  SELECT d.id, d.company_id, d.customer_id, d.conversation_id, d.source_interaction_id,
         d.channel, d.send_status, d.dispatch_started_at, d.external_message_id,
         d.outbound_interaction_id
  INTO v_delivery
  FROM public.ai_brain_live_deliveries d
  WHERE d.id = p_delivery_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'DELIVERY_NOT_FOUND';
  END IF;

  -- Validate delivery scope
  IF v_delivery.company_id <> p_company_id
     OR v_delivery.customer_id <> p_customer_id
     OR v_delivery.conversation_id <> p_conversation_id
     OR v_delivery.source_interaction_id <> p_source_interaction_id
     OR v_delivery.channel <> 'MESSENGER' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'DELIVERY_SCOPE_MISMATCH';
  END IF;

  -- First persistence must require durable authorized dispatch_started_at.
  IF v_delivery.dispatch_started_at IS NULL OR v_delivery.send_status = 'PENDING' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'DISPATCH_NOT_AUTHORIZED';
  END IF;

  -- Enforce provider message ID consistency
  IF v_delivery.external_message_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF v_delivery.external_message_id <> v_raw_mid AND v_delivery.external_message_id <> p_external_ref THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'DELIVERY_ALREADY_BOUND_TO_DIFFERENT_REF';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 4. Lock and validate conversation row & enforce Page equal to exact bound conversation Page
  SELECT c.id, c.company_id, c.customer_id, c.channel, c.status, c.external_conversation_id
  INTO v_conv
  FROM public.conversations c
  WHERE c.id = p_conversation_id
    AND c.company_id = p_company_id
    AND c.customer_id = p_customer_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND';
  END IF;

  IF v_conv.channel <> 'FACEBOOK'
     OR v_conv.external_conversation_id IS NULL
     OR v_conv.external_conversation_id !~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+$' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONVERSATION_INVALID';
  END IF;

  v_expected_page_id := split_part(v_conv.external_conversation_id, ':', 1);

  IF v_page_id <> v_expected_page_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PAGE_MISMATCH';
  END IF;

  -- 5. If delivery already has outbound_interaction_id bound, validate it and return
  IF v_delivery.outbound_interaction_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT i.id, i.company_id, i.customer_id, i.conversation_id, i.channel,
           i.type, i.direction, i.actor_type, i.external_ref
    INTO v_bound_interaction
    FROM public.interactions i
    WHERE i.id = v_delivery.outbound_interaction_id;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOUND_INTERACTION_NOT_FOUND';
    END IF;

    IF v_bound_interaction.company_id <> p_company_id
       OR v_bound_interaction.customer_id <> p_customer_id
       OR v_bound_interaction.conversation_id <> p_conversation_id
       OR v_bound_interaction.channel <> 'FACEBOOK'
       OR v_bound_interaction.type <> 'MESSAGE'
       OR v_bound_interaction.direction <> 'OUTBOUND'
       OR v_bound_interaction.actor_type <> 'AI'
       OR v_bound_interaction.external_ref <> p_external_ref THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOUND_INTERACTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH';

  END IF;

  v_existing_interaction_id := NULL;
  FOR v_candidate IN
    SELECT i.id, i.company_id, i.customer_id, i.conversation_id, i.channel,
           i.type, i.direction, i.actor_type, i.external_ref
    FROM public.interactions i
    WHERE i.company_id = p_company_id
      AND (
        i.external_ref = p_external_ref
        OR i.external_ref LIKE 'meta:%:' || v_raw_mid
        OR i.external_ref = v_raw_mid
      )

       OR v_candidate.customer_id <> p_customer_id
       OR v_candidate.conversation_id <> p_conversation_id
       OR v_candidate.channel <> 'FACEBOOK'
       OR v_candidate.type <> 'MESSAGE'
       OR v_candidate.direction <> 'OUTBOUND'
       OR v_candidate.actor_type <> 'AI' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'INTERACTION_CONFLICT';
    END IF;
    v_existing_interaction_id := v_candidate.id;
  END LOOP;

  IF v_existing_interaction_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE public.ai_brain_live_deliveries
    SET external_message_id = COALESCE(external_message_id, v_raw_mid),
        outbound_interaction_id = v_existing_interaction_id,
        updated_at = v_now
    WHERE id = p_delivery_id;

    RETURN v_existing_interaction_id;
  END IF;

  -- 7. Insert OUTBOUND interaction for timeline
  INSERT INTO public.interactions (
    company_id,
    customer_id,
    conversation_id,
    channel,
    type,
    direction,
    sanitized_content,
    sanitization_status,
    sanitized_at,
    sanitizer_version,
    external_ref,
    actor_type,
    actor_user_id,
    created_at
  ) VALUES (
    p_company_id,
    p_customer_id,
    p_conversation_id,
    'FACEBOOK',
    'MESSAGE',
    'OUTBOUND',
    p_content,
    'SUCCEEDED',
    v_now,
    'ai-messenger-live-v1',
    p_external_ref,
    'AI',
    NULL,
    v_now
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_interaction_id;

  -- 8. Insert raw payload for auditability
  INSERT INTO private.interaction_raw_contents (
    interaction_id,
    company_id,
    raw_content,
    raw_payload,
    source_metadata
  ) VALUES (
    v_interaction_id,
    p_company_id,
    p_content,
    jsonb_build_object('external_ref', p_external_ref, 'raw_mid', v_raw_mid),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'source', 'ai_messenger_live_delivery',
      'delivery_id', p_delivery_id,
      'source_interaction_id', p_source_interaction_id,
      'actor_type', 'AI'
    )
  );

  -- 9. Atomically bind delivery record with raw provider MID and outbound_interaction_id
  UPDATE public.ai_brain_live_deliveries
  SET external_message_id = v_raw_mid,
      outbound_interaction_id = v_interaction_id,
      updated_at = v_now
  WHERE id = p_delivery_id;

  -- 10. Update conversation activity timestamp and status
  UPDATE public.conversations c
  SET last_message_at = greatest(coalesce(c.last_message_at, v_now), v_now),
      status = CASE WHEN c.status = 'AI_HANDLING' THEN 'OPEN' ELSE c.status END
  WHERE c.id = p_conversation_id
    AND c.company_id = p_company_id;

  -- 11. Resolve Response SLA window if open (includes resolved_at and dispatch_state)
  UPDATE public.response_sla_windows
  SET state = 'AI_RESPONDED',
      ai_response_interaction_id = v_interaction_id,
      resolved_at = v_now,
      dispatch_state = 'PROVIDER_ACCEPTED',
      updated_at = v_now
  WHERE company_id = p_company_id
    AND conversation_id = p_conversation_id
    AND state = 'OPEN';

  RETURN v_interaction_id;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_ai_handover_case(
  p_company_id uuid,
  p_customer_id uuid,
  p_conversation_id uuid,
  p_source_interaction_id uuid,
  p_reason text,
  p_priority text DEFAULT 'NORMAL',
  p_brain_turn_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,
  p_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
)
RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_case_id uuid;
  v_channel text;
BEGIN
  IF p_company_id IS NULL OR p_customer_id IS NULL OR p_conversation_id IS NULL OR p_source_interaction_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_REQUEST';
  END IF;

  IF p_reason NOT IN (
    'CUSTOMER_REQUESTED_HUMAN', 'CUSTOMER_COMPLAINT', 'REFUND_REQUEST',
    'PRICE_QUOTATION_REQUIRED', 'LEGAL_OR_POLICY', 'PAYMENT_ISSUE',
    'LOW_CONFIDENCE', 'INSUFFICIENT_KNOWLEDGE', 'HIGH_VALUE_LEAD', 'OTHER'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_HANDOVER_REASON';
  END IF;

  IF p_priority NOT IN ('URGENT', 'HIGH', 'NORMAL', 'LOW') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_HANDOVER_PRIORITY';
  END IF;

  -- Verify conversation exists
  SELECT channel INTO v_channel
  FROM public.conversations
  WHERE id = p_conversation_id
    AND company_id = p_company_id
    AND customer_id = p_customer_id;

  IF v_channel IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND';
  END IF;

  -- Insert or update existing case for this interaction
  INSERT INTO public.ai_handover_cases (
    company_id, customer_id, conversation_id, source_interaction_id,
    reason, priority, status, brain_turn_id, metadata, created_at, updated_at
  ) VALUES (
    p_company_id, p_customer_id, p_conversation_id, p_source_interaction_id,
    p_reason, p_priority, 'OPEN', p_brain_turn_id, coalesce(p_metadata, '{}'::jsonb), now(), now()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (company_id, source_interaction_id) DO UPDATE
    SET priority = CASE
          WHEN EXCLUDED.priority = 'URGENT' THEN 'URGENT'
          WHEN ai_handover_cases.priority = 'URGENT' THEN 'URGENT'
          WHEN EXCLUDED.priority = 'HIGH' THEN 'HIGH'
          ELSE ai_handover_cases.priority
        END,
        updated_at = now()
  RETURNING id INTO v_case_id;

  IF v_case_id IS NULL THEN
    SELECT id INTO v_case_id
    FROM public.ai_handover_cases
    WHERE company_id = p_company_id AND source_interaction_id = p_source_interaction_id;
  END IF;

  -- Update conversation state: set status = 'PENDING_SALE'
  -- Keep ai_mode = 'ACTIVE' for FACEBOOK so AI continues to auto-reply without pausing!
  UPDATE public.conversations
  SET status = 'PENDING_SALE',
      ai_mode = CASE WHEN v_channel = 'FACEBOOK' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'PAUSED' END,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = p_conversation_id
    AND company_id = p_company_id;

  -- Record timeline event if not already recorded
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.interactions
    WHERE company_id = p_company_id
      AND conversation_id = p_conversation_id
      AND external_ref = 'handover:' || p_source_interaction_id::text
  ) THEN
    INSERT INTO public.interactions (
      company_id,
      customer_id,
      conversation_id,
      channel,
      type,
      direction,
      sanitized_content,
      sanitization_status,
      sanitized_at,
      external_ref,
      actor_type,
      created_at
    ) VALUES (
      p_company_id,
      p_customer_id,
      p_conversation_id,
      v_channel,
      'STATUS_EVENT',
      'OUTBOUND',
      'AI Handover: ' || p_reason || ' [' || p_priority || ']',
      'SUCCEEDED',
      now(),
      'handover:' || p_source_interaction_id::text,
      'AI',
      now()
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN v_case_id;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.c360_list(
  p_company_id uuid,
  p_search text DEFAULT '',
  p_page integer DEFAULT 1,
  p_owner uuid DEFAULT NULL,
  p_channel text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_stage text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_hot boolean DEFAULT false,
  p_overdue boolean DEFAULT false,
  p_recent boolean DEFAULT false,
  p_sort text DEFAULT 'updated',
  p_include_ai boolean DEFAULT false
)
RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
DECLARE result jsonb; BEGIN
  IF p_page NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 OR length(p_search) > 200 OR p_sort NOT IN ('updated','name','contact','score','followup')
    OR (p_channel IS NOT NULL AND p_channel NOT IN ('ZALO','FACEBOOK','PHONE','EMAIL')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_FILTER'; END IF;
  WITH rows AS (
    SELECT c.id, c.customer_code, c.name, c.stage, c.source, c.updated_at,
      p.address, p.birth_year, p.special_notes,
      coalesce(p.assigned_sale_id, owner.assigned_to) AS assigned_sale_id,
      coalesce(nullif(trim(p.assigned_sale_name), ''), u.full_name) AS assigned_sale,
      p.assigned_sale_name,
      coalesce(p.sale_notes, p.special_notes) AS sale_notes,
      p.marketing_notes,
      coalesce(p.ai_notes, s.snapshot->'currentSituation'->>'text') AS ai_notes,
      ids.zalo_name, ids.facebook_name, ids.channels, em.email,
      CASE WHEN ph.normalized_phone IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE left(ph.normalized_phone, 4)||'******'||right(ph.normalized_phone, 2) END AS phone,
      s.snapshot->'currentSituation'->>'text' AS current_situation, s.lead_score, s.follow_up_at, s.generated_at AS ai_updated_at,
      greatest(msg.at, zc.at) AS last_interaction,
      count(*) OVER() AS total
    FROM public.customers c
    LEFT JOIN public.customer_dossier_profiles p ON p.company_id = c.company_id AND p.customer_id = c.id
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT assigned_to FROM public.conversations conv WHERE conv.company_id = c.company_id
      AND conv.customer_id = c.id AND conv.assigned_to IS NOT NULL ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id LIMIT 1) owner ON true
    LEFT JOIN public.user_profiles u ON u.id = coalesce(p.assigned_sale_id, owner.assigned_to)
    LEFT JOIN private.customer_private_contacts ph ON ph.company_id = c.company_id AND ph.customer_id = c.id
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT v.normalized_value AS email FROM private.customer_identity_values v
      WHERE v.company_id = c.company_id AND v.customer_id = c.id ORDER BY v.identity_id LIMIT 1) em ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT max(coalesce(i.display_name, i.metadata->>'display_name')) FILTER(WHERE channel = 'ZALO') AS zalo_name,
      max(coalesce(i.display_name, i.metadata->>'display_name')) FILTER(WHERE channel = 'FACEBOOK') AS facebook_name,
      array_agg(DISTINCT channel) AS channels FROM public.identities i WHERE i.company_id = c.company_id AND i.customer_id = c.id) ids ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT a.snapshot, a.lead_score, a.follow_up_at, a.generated_at FROM public.customer_ai_snapshots a
      WHERE p_include_ai AND a.company_id = c.company_id AND a.customer_id = c.id ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT max(created_at) AS at FROM public.interactions i WHERE i.company_id = c.company_id AND i.customer_id = c.id) msg ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT max(started_at) AS at FROM public.zalo_personal_calls z WHERE z.company_id = c.company_id AND z.customer_id = c.id) zc ON true
    WHERE c.company_id = p_company_id
      AND (p_search = '' OR c.name ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%' OR ph.normalized_phone ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%'
        OR em.email ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%'
        OR p.assigned_sale_name ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%'
        OR u.full_name ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%'
        OR p.sale_notes ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%'
        OR p.marketing_notes ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%'
        OR p.ai_notes ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%'
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.identities si
          WHERE si.company_id = c.company_id AND si.customer_id = c.id AND si.channel IN ('ZALO', 'FACEBOOK')
            AND (si.display_name ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%' OR si.metadata->>'display_name' ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%')))
      AND (p_owner IS NULL OR coalesce(p.assigned_sale_id, owner.assigned_to) = p_owner)
      AND (p_channel IS NULL OR p_channel = ANY(ids.channels))
      AND (p_stage IS NULL OR c.stage = p_stage)
      AND (NOT p_hot OR s.lead_score >= 70)
      AND (NOT p_overdue OR s.follow_up_at < now())
      AND (NOT p_recent OR greatest(msg.at, zc.at) > now() - interval '7 days')
  ), page AS (
    SELECT * FROM rows ORDER BY
      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'name' THEN name END ASC,
      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'contact' THEN last_interaction END DESC NULLS LAST,
      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'score' THEN lead_score END DESC NULLS LAST,
      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'followup' THEN follow_up_at END ASC NULLS LAST,
      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'updated' THEN updated_at END DESC, id
    LIMIT 25 OFFSET (p_page - 1) * 25
  ) SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'items', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(page) - 'total') FROM page), '[]'::jsonb),
    'total', coalesce((SELECT max(total) FROM rows), 0),
    'page', p_page,
    'pageSize', 25
  ) INTO result;
  RETURN result;
END $$;

            AND (si.display_name ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%' OR si.metadata->>'display_name' ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%')))
      AND (p_owner IS NULL OR coalesce(p.assigned_sale_id, owner.assigned_to) = p_owner)
      AND (p_channel IS NULL OR p_channel = ANY(ids.channels))
      AND (p_stage IS NULL OR c.stage = p_stage)
      AND (NOT p_hot OR s.lead_score >= 70)
      AND (NOT p_overdue OR s.follow_up_at < now())
      AND (NOT p_recent OR greatest(msg.at, zc.at) > now() - interval '7 days')
  ), page AS (
    SELECT * FROM rows ORDER BY
      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'name' THEN name END ASC,
      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'contact' THEN last_interaction END DESC NULLS LAST,
      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'score' THEN lead_score END DESC NULLS LAST,
      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'followup' THEN follow_up_at END ASC NULLS LAST,
      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'updated' THEN updated_at END DESC, id
    LIMIT 25 OFFSET (p_page - 1) * 25
  ) SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'items', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(page) - 'total') FROM page), '[]'::jsonb),
    'total', coalesce((SELECT max(total) FROM rows), 0),
    'page', p_page,
    'pageSize', 25
  ) INTO result;
  RETURN result;
END $$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_observed_zcajs_outbound_atomic(
  p_company_id uuid,
  p_external_conversation_id text,
  p_provider_msg_id text,
  p_sanitized_content text,
  p_raw_content text DEFAULT '',
  p_source_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  p_timestamp timestamptz DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_conversation public.conversations%ROWTYPE;
  v_existing public.interactions%ROWTYPE;
  v_customer_id uuid;
  v_interaction_id uuid;
  v_existing_delivery public.outbound_deliveries%ROWTYPE;
  v_external_ref text;
  v_peer_id text;
  v_msg_id text;
  v_event_time timestamptz := coalesce(p_timestamp, clock_timestamp());
  v_now timestamptz := clock_timestamp();
  v_metadata jsonb := coalesce(p_source_metadata, '{}'::jsonb);
  v_is_group boolean := lower(coalesce(p_source_metadata->>'is_group', 'false')) = 'true';
  v_group_name text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_source_metadata->>'group_name', '')), '');
  v_group_id text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_source_metadata->>'group_id', '')), '');
  v_customer_name text;
  v_display_metadata jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF p_company_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ZCAJS_COMPANY_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  v_peer_id := nullif(btrim(p_external_conversation_id), '');
  v_msg_id := nullif(btrim(p_provider_msg_id), '');
  IF v_peer_id IS NULL OR v_msg_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ZCAJS_PEER_AND_MESSAGE_ID_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF v_group_name IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_display_metadata := jsonb_build_object(
      'zalo_display_name', v_group_name,
      'zalo_display_name_source', 'group_info',
      'zalo_display_name_updated_at', v_now
    );
  END IF;

  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    hashtextextended(p_company_id::text || ':zcajs-observed:' || v_msg_id, 0)
  );

  -- If CRM itself sent this provider message, the canonical interaction already owns it.
  SELECT * INTO v_existing_delivery
  FROM public.outbound_deliveries d
  WHERE d.company_id = p_company_id
    AND d.channel = 'ZALO'
    AND d.provider_message_id = v_msg_id
  ORDER BY d.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_existing_delivery.id IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'conversation_id', v_existing_delivery.conversation_id,
      'interaction_id', v_existing_delivery.interaction_id,
      'customer_id', NULL,
      'is_duplicate', true,
      'origin', 'CRM_DISPATCH'
    );
  END IF;

  v_external_ref := 'zcajs:self:'
    || CASE WHEN v_is_group THEN 'group:' ELSE '' END
    || v_msg_id;

  SELECT * INTO v_existing
  FROM public.interactions i
  WHERE i.company_id = p_company_id
    AND i.channel = 'ZALO'
    AND i.external_ref = v_external_ref
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_existing.id IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'conversation_id', v_existing.conversation_id,
      'interaction_id', v_existing.id,
      'customer_id', v_existing.customer_id,
      'is_duplicate', true,
      'origin', 'OBSERVED_ZALO'
    );
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_conversation
  FROM public.conversations c
  WHERE c.company_id = p_company_id
    AND c.channel = 'ZALO'
    AND c.external_conversation_id = v_peer_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF v_conversation.id IS NULL THEN
    v_customer_name := coalesce(
      v_group_name,
      CASE
        WHEN v_is_group THEN 'Nhóm Zalo ' || right(coalesce(v_group_id, regexp_replace(v_peer_id, '^group:', '')), 4)
        ELSE 'Khách Zalo ' || right(v_peer_id, 4)
      END
    );

    INSERT INTO public.customers (
      company_id,
      name,
      source,
      stage,
      created_at,
      updated_at
    ) VALUES (
      p_company_id,
      v_customer_name,
      'ZALO',
      'LEAD_NEW',
      v_now,
      v_now
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_customer_id;

    INSERT INTO public.conversations (
      company_id,
      customer_id,
      channel,
      external_conversation_id,
      last_message_at,
      unread_count,
      status,
      metadata,
      created_at,
      updated_at
    ) VALUES (
      p_company_id,
      v_customer_id,
      'ZALO',
      v_peer_id,
      v_event_time,
      0,
      'OPEN',
      jsonb_build_object(
        'provider', 'zcajs',
        'transport', 'ZCAJS',
        'external_user_id', v_peer_id
      ) || v_metadata || v_display_metadata,
      v_now,
      v_now
    )
    RETURNING * INTO v_conversation;
  ELSE
    v_customer_id := v_conversation.customer_id;

    IF v_group_name IS NOT NULL THEN
      UPDATE public.customers
      SET name = v_group_name,
          updated_at = v_now
      WHERE id = v_customer_id
        AND public.is_generic_customer_name(name);
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.conversations
    SET metadata = coalesce(metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || v_metadata || v_display_metadata
    WHERE id = v_conversation.id
      AND company_id = p_company_id;
  END IF;

  -- Keep the identity graph complete even when the first observed message for a
  -- peer came from the native Zalo app instead of an inbound webhook.
  INSERT INTO public.identities (
    company_id,
    customer_id,
    channel,
    external_id,
    verified,
    metadata,
    display_name,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  ) VALUES (
    p_company_id,
    v_customer_id,
    'ZALO',
    v_peer_id,
    false,
    jsonb_build_object('provider', 'zcajs', 'is_group', v_is_group),
    v_group_name,
    v_now,
    v_now
  )
  ON CONFLICT (company_id, channel, external_id) DO UPDATE
    SET display_name = coalesce(public.identities.display_name, excluded.display_name),
        updated_at = v_now;

  v_interaction_id := gen_random_uuid();

  INSERT INTO public.interactions (
    id,
    company_id,
    customer_id,
    conversation_id,
    channel,
    type,
    direction,
    sanitized_content,
    sanitization_status,
    sanitized_at,
    sanitizer_version,
    external_ref,
    actor_type,
    actor_user_id,
    created_at
  ) VALUES (
    v_interaction_id,
    p_company_id,
    v_customer_id,
    v_conversation.id,
    'ZALO',
    'MESSAGE',
    'OUTBOUND',
    coalesce(p_sanitized_content, ''),
    'SUCCEEDED',
    v_now,
    'v1',
    v_external_ref,
    'SALE',
    NULL,
    v_event_time
  );

  INSERT INTO private.interaction_raw_contents (
    interaction_id,
    company_id,
    raw_content,
    raw_payload,
    source_metadata,
    created_at
  ) VALUES (
    v_interaction_id,
    p_company_id,
    coalesce(p_raw_content, ''),
    v_metadata,
    v_metadata,
    v_event_time
  );

  UPDATE public.conversations
  SET last_message_at = greatest(coalesce(last_message_at, v_event_time), v_event_time),
      status = 'OPEN',
      updated_at = v_now
  WHERE id = v_conversation.id
    AND company_id = p_company_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'conversation_id', v_conversation.id,
    'interaction_id', v_interaction_id,
    'customer_id', v_customer_id,
    'is_duplicate', false,
    'origin', 'OBSERVED_ZALO',
    'is_group', v_is_group
  );
END;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.c360_timeline(p_company_id uuid,p_customer_id uuid,p_page integer DEFAULT 1,
  p_filter text DEFAULT 'ALL',p_staff_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,p_include_ai boolean DEFAULT false)
RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
DECLARE result jsonb; BEGIN
  IF p_page NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 OR p_filter NOT IN ('ALL','MESSAGE','CALL','NOTE','AI','EVENT')
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_FILTER'; END IF;
  WITH events AS (
    SELECT 'interaction:'||i.id AS id,CASE i.type WHEN 'MESSAGE' THEN 'MESSAGE' WHEN 'NOTE' THEN 'NOTE'
      WHEN 'CALL_EVENT' THEN 'CALL' ELSE 'EVENT' END AS kind,i.channel,i.direction,
      i.created_at AS at,i.sanitized_content AS content,i.id AS source_id
      FROM public.interactions i WHERE i.company_id=p_company_id AND i.customer_id=p_customer_id
        AND i.sanitization_status IN ('SUCCEEDED','NOT_REQUIRED')
        AND NOT(i.type='CALL_EVENT' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.zalo_personal_calls z
          WHERE z.company_id=i.company_id AND z.customer_id=i.customer_id AND i.external_ref=z.id::text)
          OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.calls c WHERE c.company_id=i.company_id AND c.customer_id=i.customer_id AND i.external_ref=c.id::text)))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'recording:'||z.id,'CALL',z.channel,z.direction,z.started_at,
      concat('Cuộc gọi Zalo · ',round(z.duration_seconds)::text,' giây · ',z.recording_status),z.id
      FROM public.zalo_personal_calls z WHERE z.company_id=p_company_id AND z.customer_id=p_customer_id
        AND (p_staff_id IS NULL OR z.staff_user_id=p_staff_id)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'call:'||c.id,'CALL',c.provider,c.direction,c.started_at,'Cuộc gọi · '||c.status,c.id
      FROM public.calls c WHERE p_include_ai AND c.company_id=p_company_id AND c.customer_id=p_customer_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'snapshot:'||s.id,'AI','AI',NULL,s.generated_at,s.snapshot->'summary'->>'text',s.id
      FROM public.customer_ai_snapshots s WHERE p_include_ai AND s.company_id=p_company_id AND s.customer_id=p_customer_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'stage:'||h.id,'EVENT','CRM',NULL,h.changed_at,h.from_stage||' → '||h.to_stage,h.id
      FROM public.customer_stage_histories h WHERE h.company_id=p_company_id AND h.customer_id=p_customer_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'handover:'||h.id,'EVENT','CRM',NULL,h.created_at,'Chuyển giao cho sale: '||h.reason,h.id
      FROM public.ai_handover_cases h WHERE h.company_id=p_company_id AND h.customer_id=p_customer_id
  ), filtered AS(SELECT * FROM events WHERE p_filter='ALL' OR kind=p_filter), page AS(
    SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 30 OFFSET (p_page-1)*30
  ) SELECT jsonb_build_object('items',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(page) ORDER BY at DESC,id DESC) FROM page),'[]'::jsonb),
    'total',(SELECT count(*) FROM filtered),'page',p_page,'pageSize',30) INTO result;
  RETURN result;
END $$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_lead_attribution_touchpoint(
    p_company uuid,
    p_customer uuid DEFAULT NULL,
    p_interaction uuid DEFAULT NULL,
    p_conversation uuid DEFAULT NULL,
    p_channel text DEFAULT 'FACEBOOK_LEAD_ADS',
    p_page_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_page_name text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_ad_account_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_meta_campaign_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_campaign_name text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_meta_ad_set_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_ad_set_name text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_meta_ad_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_ad_name text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_meta_form_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_form_name text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_meta_leadgen_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_referral_source text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_referral_type text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_ads_context_data jsonb DEFAULT NULL,
    p_utm_source text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_utm_medium text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_utm_campaign text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_utm_content text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_utm_term text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_fbclid text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_attribution_status text DEFAULT 'UNATTRIBUTED',
    p_attribution_method text DEFAULT 'DIRECT_LEADGEN',
    p_occurred timestamptz DEFAULT now()
)
RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_touchpoint_id uuid;
    v_has_previous boolean := false;
    v_type text := 'FIRST_TOUCH';
    v_existing_id uuid;
    v_resolved_campaign_id text := p_meta_campaign_id;
    v_resolved_ad_set_id text := p_meta_ad_set_id;
    v_resolved_campaign text := p_campaign_name;
    v_resolved_ad_set text := p_ad_set_name;
    v_resolved_ad text := p_ad_name;
    v_resolved_form text := p_form_name;
    v_status text := p_attribution_status;
BEGIN
    -- Idempotency check for leadgen_id
    IF p_meta_leadgen_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT id INTO v_existing_id
        FROM public.lead_attribution_touchpoints
        WHERE company_id = p_company
          AND meta_leadgen_id = p_meta_leadgen_id;

        IF v_existing_id IS NOT NULL THEN
            RETURN v_existing_id;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    -- Look up snapshots from synced Meta Ads metadata if names are not provided
    IF p_meta_ad_id IS NOT NULL AND (v_resolved_ad IS NULL OR v_resolved_campaign_id IS NULL) THEN
        SELECT a.name, s.name, c.name, a.meta_campaign_id, a.meta_ad_set_id
        INTO v_resolved_ad, v_resolved_ad_set, v_resolved_campaign, v_resolved_campaign_id, v_resolved_ad_set_id
        FROM public.meta_ads a
        LEFT JOIN public.meta_ad_sets s ON s.company_id = p_company AND s.meta_ad_set_id = a.meta_ad_set_id
        LEFT JOIN public.meta_campaigns c ON c.company_id = p_company AND c.meta_campaign_id = a.meta_campaign_id
        WHERE a.company_id = p_company AND a.meta_ad_id = p_meta_ad_id;

        IF v_resolved_campaign IS NOT NULL AND v_status = 'UNATTRIBUTED' THEN
            v_status := 'ATTRIBUTED';
        END IF;
    END IF;

    IF p_meta_form_id IS NOT NULL AND v_resolved_form IS NULL THEN
        SELECT f.name INTO v_resolved_form
        FROM public.meta_lead_forms f
        WHERE f.company_id = p_company AND f.meta_form_id = p_meta_form_id;
    END IF;

    -- Determine FIRST_TOUCH vs LATEST_TOUCH
    IF p_customer IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.lead_attribution_touchpoints
            WHERE company_id = p_company AND customer_id = p_customer
        ) INTO v_has_previous;

        IF v_has_previous THEN
            v_type := 'LATEST_TOUCH';
        ELSE
            v_type := 'FIRST_TOUCH';
        END IF;
    END IF;

    -- Insert touchpoint
    INSERT INTO public.lead_attribution_touchpoints (
        company_id,
        customer_id,
        interaction_id,
        conversation_id,
        touchpoint_type,
        channel,
        page_id,
        page_name,
        ad_account_id,
        meta_campaign_id,
        campaign_name_snapshot,
        meta_ad_set_id,
        ad_set_name_snapshot,
        meta_ad_id,
        ad_name_snapshot,
        meta_form_id,
        form_name_snapshot,
        meta_leadgen_id,
        referral_source,
        referral_type,
        ads_context_data,
        utm_source,
        utm_medium,
        utm_campaign,
        utm_content,
        utm_term,
        fbclid,
        attribution_status,
        attribution_method,
        occurred_at,
        created_at
    )
    VALUES (
        p_company,
        p_customer,
        p_interaction,
        p_conversation,
        v_type,
        p_channel,
        p_page_id,
        p_page_name,
        p_ad_account_id,
        COALESCE(p_meta_campaign_id, v_resolved_campaign_id),
        v_resolved_campaign,
        COALESCE(p_meta_ad_set_id, v_resolved_ad_set_id),
        v_resolved_ad_set,
        p_meta_ad_id,
        v_resolved_ad,
        p_meta_form_id,
        v_resolved_form,
        p_meta_leadgen_id,
        p_referral_source,
        p_referral_type,
        p_ads_context_data,
        p_utm_source,
        p_utm_medium,
        p_utm_campaign,
        p_utm_content,
        p_utm_term,
        p_fbclid,
        v_status,
        p_attribution_method,
        COALESCE(p_occurred, now()),
        now()
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_touchpoint_id;

    -- Update Customer snapshot fields atomically
    IF p_customer IS NOT NULL THEN
        IF NOT v_has_previous THEN
            UPDATE public.customers
            SET
                first_campaign_name = v_resolved_campaign,
                first_ad_name = v_resolved_ad,
                first_touch_at = COALESCE(p_occurred, now()),
                latest_campaign_name = v_resolved_campaign,
                latest_ad_name = v_resolved_ad,
                latest_touch_at = COALESCE(p_occurred, now()),
                attribution_status = v_status,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE id = p_customer AND company_id = p_company;
        ELSE
            UPDATE public.customers
            SET
                latest_campaign_name = COALESCE(v_resolved_campaign, latest_campaign_name),
                latest_ad_name = COALESCE(v_resolved_ad, latest_ad_name),
                latest_touch_at = COALESCE(p_occurred, now()),
                attribution_status = CASE
                    WHEN v_status = 'ATTRIBUTED' THEN 'ATTRIBUTED'
                    ELSE attribution_status
                END,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE id = p_customer AND company_id = p_company;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    RETURN v_touchpoint_id;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_meta_ads_performance_report(
    p_company uuid,
    p_from timestamptz,
    p_to timestamptz,
    p_ad_account_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_campaign_id text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_total_spend numeric := 0;
    v_total_impressions bigint := 0;
    v_total_clicks bigint := 0;
    v_total_meta_leads integer := 0;
    v_total_crm_leads bigint := 0;
    v_total_attributed_leads bigint := 0;
    v_total_qualified_leads bigint := 0;
    v_ctr numeric := 0;
    v_cpl numeric := 0;
    v_cost_per_qualified numeric := 0;
    v_campaign_rows jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
BEGIN
    -- Aggregate Meta daily insights
    SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(spend), 0),
        COALESCE(SUM(impressions), 0),
        COALESCE(SUM(clicks), 0),
        COALESCE(SUM(meta_leads), 0)
    INTO
        v_total_spend,
        v_total_impressions,
        v_total_clicks,
        v_total_meta_leads
    FROM public.meta_insights_daily
    WHERE company_id = p_company
      AND date >= p_from::date
      AND date <= p_to::date
      AND entity_type = 'ACCOUNT'
      AND (p_ad_account_id IS NULL OR ad_account_id = p_ad_account_id);

    -- Calculate CTR
    IF v_total_impressions > 0 THEN
        v_ctr := ROUND((v_total_clicks::numeric / v_total_impressions::numeric) * 100, 2);
    ELSE
        v_ctr := 0;
    END IF;

    -- Aggregate CRM actual received leads in period
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id)
    INTO v_total_crm_leads
    FROM public.lead_attribution_touchpoints t
    WHERE t.company_id = p_company
      AND t.occurred_at >= p_from
      AND t.occurred_at <= p_to
      AND (p_ad_account_id IS NULL OR t.ad_account_id = p_ad_account_id)
      AND (p_campaign_id IS NULL OR t.meta_campaign_id = p_campaign_id);

    -- Aggregate CRM attributed leads in period
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id)
    INTO v_total_attributed_leads
    FROM public.lead_attribution_touchpoints t
    WHERE t.company_id = p_company
      AND t.occurred_at >= p_from
      AND t.occurred_at <= p_to
      AND t.attribution_status = 'ATTRIBUTED'
      AND (p_ad_account_id IS NULL OR t.ad_account_id = p_ad_account_id)
      AND (p_campaign_id IS NULL OR t.meta_campaign_id = p_campaign_id);

    -- Calculate CRM CPL (safe division)
    IF v_total_attributed_leads > 0 THEN
        v_cpl := ROUND(v_total_spend / v_total_attributed_leads, 0);
    ELSE
        v_cpl := 0;
    END IF;

    -- Aggregate Qualified Leads
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)
    INTO v_total_qualified_leads
    FROM public.lead_attribution_touchpoints t
    JOIN public.customers c ON c.id = t.customer_id AND c.company_id = p_company
    WHERE t.company_id = p_company
      AND t.occurred_at >= p_from
      AND t.occurred_at <= p_to
      AND t.attribution_status = 'ATTRIBUTED'
      AND c.stage IN ('INTERESTED', 'HIGH_POTENTIAL', 'DEPOSIT_PENDING', 'DEPOSIT_CONFIRMED', 'CONTRACT_SIGNED', 'interested', 'deep_research', 'high_potential', 'contract_signed')
      AND (p_ad_account_id IS NULL OR t.ad_account_id = p_ad_account_id)
      AND (p_campaign_id IS NULL OR t.meta_campaign_id = p_campaign_id);

    IF v_total_qualified_leads > 0 THEN
        v_cost_per_qualified := ROUND(v_total_spend / v_total_qualified_leads, 0);
    ELSE
        v_cost_per_qualified := 0;
    END IF;

    -- Campaign breakdown
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(sub), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_campaign_rows
    FROM (
        SELECT
            c.meta_campaign_id AS campaign_id,
            c.name AS campaign_name,
            c.status AS campaign_status,
            COALESCE(ins.spend, 0) AS spend,
            COALESCE(ins.impressions, 0) AS impressions,
            COALESCE(ins.clicks, 0) AS clicks,
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(ins.impressions, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(ins.clicks, 0)::numeric / ins.impressions::numeric) * 100, 2)
                ELSE 0
            END AS ctr,
            COALESCE(ins.meta_leads, 0) AS meta_leads,
            COALESCE(crm.crm_leads, 0) AS crm_leads,
            COALESCE(crm.attributed_leads, 0) AS attributed_leads,
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(crm.attributed_leads, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(ins.spend, 0) / crm.attributed_leads, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END AS cpl
        FROM public.meta_campaigns c
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT
                entity_id,
                SUM(spend) AS spend,
                SUM(impressions) AS impressions,
                SUM(clicks) AS clicks,
                SUM(meta_leads) AS meta_leads
            FROM public.meta_insights_daily
            WHERE company_id = p_company
              AND date >= p_from::date
              AND date <= p_to::date
              AND entity_type = 'CAMPAIGN'
            GROUP BY entity_id
        ) ins ON ins.entity_id = c.meta_campaign_id
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT
                meta_campaign_id,
                COUNT(id) AS crm_leads,
                COUNT(id) FILTER (WHERE attribution_status = 'ATTRIBUTED') AS attributed_leads
            FROM public.lead_attribution_touchpoints
            WHERE company_id = p_company
              AND occurred_at >= p_from
              AND occurred_at <= p_to
            GROUP BY meta_campaign_id
        ) crm ON crm.meta_campaign_id = c.meta_campaign_id
        WHERE c.company_id = p_company
          AND (p_ad_account_id IS NULL OR c.ad_account_id = p_ad_account_id)
          AND (p_campaign_id IS NULL OR c.meta_campaign_id = p_campaign_id)
        ORDER BY spend DESC, crm_leads DESC
    ) sub;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'overview', jsonb_build_object(
            'spend', v_total_spend,
            'impressions', v_total_impressions,
            'clicks', v_total_clicks,
            'ctr', v_ctr,
            'meta_leads', v_total_meta_leads,
            'crm_leads', v_total_crm_leads,
            'attributed_leads', v_total_attributed_leads,
            'qualified_leads', v_total_qualified_leads,
            'cpl', v_cpl,
            'cost_per_qualified', v_cost_per_qualified
        ),
        'campaigns', v_campaign_rows
    );
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.store_meta_ad_account_token(
    p_company_id uuid,
    p_ad_account_id text,
    p_encrypted_access_token text,
    p_token_expires_at timestamptz DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, private, pg_temp
AS $$
BEGIN
    -- Authorization check: if authenticated user, must be ACTIVE member of p_company_id
    IF auth.role() = 'authenticated' THEN
        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.company_members cm
            WHERE cm.company_id = p_company_id
              AND cm.user_id = auth.uid()
              AND cm.status = 'ACTIVE'
        ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNAUTHORIZED_COMPANY_ACCESS: user % not authorized for company %', auth.uid(), p_company_id;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    -- Verify company exists
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.companies WHERE id = p_company_id) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_COMPANY_ID: company % does not exist', p_company_id;
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO private.meta_ad_account_tokens (
        company_id,
        ad_account_id,
        encrypted_access_token,
        token_expires_at,
        updated_at
    )
    VALUES (
        p_company_id,
        p_ad_account_id,
        p_encrypted_access_token,
        p_token_expires_at,
        now()
    )
    ON CONFLICT (company_id, ad_account_id) DO UPDATE
    SET
        encrypted_access_token = EXCLUDED.encrypted_access_token,
        token_expires_at = EXCLUDED.token_expires_at,
        updated_at = now();

    -- Touch updated_at on public.meta_ad_accounts
    UPDATE public.meta_ad_accounts
    SET updated_at = now()
    WHERE company_id = p_company_id AND ad_account_id = p_ad_account_id;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_meta_leadgen_event(
    p_company_id uuid,
    p_page_id text,
    p_leadgen_id text,
    p_form_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_ad_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_occurred timestamptz DEFAULT now()
)
RETURNS text
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, private, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_status text;
BEGIN
    SELECT status INTO v_status
    FROM private.meta_leadgen_events
    WHERE company_id = p_company_id AND leadgen_id = p_leadgen_id;

    IF v_status = 'PROCESSED' THEN
        RETURN 'ALREADY_PROCESSED';
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO private.meta_leadgen_events (
        company_id,
        page_id,
        leadgen_id,
        form_id,
        ad_id,
        status,
        retry_count,
        occurred_at,
        updated_at
    )
    VALUES (
        p_company_id,
        p_page_id,
        p_leadgen_id,
        p_form_id,
        p_ad_id,
        'PROCESSING',
        0,
        p_occurred,
        now()
    )
    ON CONFLICT (company_id, leadgen_id) DO UPDATE
    SET
        status = 'PROCESSING',
        retry_count = private.meta_leadgen_events.retry_count + 1,
        form_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.form_id, private.meta_leadgen_events.form_id),
        ad_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.ad_id, private.meta_leadgen_events.ad_id),
        updated_at = now();

    RETURN 'CLAIMED';
END;
$$;
