CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_lead_attribution_touchpoint(
    p_company uuid,
    p_customer uuid DEFAULT NULL,
    p_interaction uuid DEFAULT NULL,
    p_conversation uuid DEFAULT NULL,
    p_channel text DEFAULT 'FACEBOOK_LEAD_ADS',
    p_page_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_page_name text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_ad_account_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_meta_campaign_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_campaign_name text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_meta_ad_set_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_ad_set_name text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_meta_ad_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_ad_name text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_meta_form_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_form_name text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_meta_leadgen_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_referral_source text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_referral_type text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_ads_context_data jsonb DEFAULT NULL,
    p_utm_source text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_utm_medium text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_utm_campaign text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_utm_content text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_utm_term text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_fbclid text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_attribution_status text DEFAULT 'UNATTRIBUTED',
    p_attribution_method text DEFAULT 'DIRECT_LEADGEN',
    p_occurred timestamptz DEFAULT now()
)
RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_touchpoint_id uuid;
    v_has_previous boolean := false;
    v_type text := 'FIRST_TOUCH';
    v_existing_id uuid;
    v_resolved_campaign_id text := p_meta_campaign_id;
    v_resolved_ad_set_id text := p_meta_ad_set_id;
    v_resolved_campaign text := p_campaign_name;
    v_resolved_ad_set text := p_ad_set_name;
    v_resolved_ad text := p_ad_name;
    v_resolved_form text := p_form_name;
    v_status text := p_attribution_status;
BEGIN
    -- 1. STRICT AUTHORIZATION CHECK (Priority 2)
    IF auth.role() = 'authenticated' THEN
        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.company_members cm
            WHERE cm.company_id = p_company
              AND cm.user_id = auth.uid()
              AND cm.status = 'ACTIVE'
        ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNAUTHORIZED_COMPANY_ACCESS: user % not authorized for company %', auth.uid(), p_company;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    -- 2. Verify company exists
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.companies WHERE id = p_company) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_COMPANY_ID: company % does not exist', p_company;
    END IF;

    -- 3. Scope validation for foreign keys
    IF p_customer IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.customers WHERE id = p_customer AND company_id = p_company) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CUSTOMER_COMPANY_MISMATCH: customer % does not belong to company %', p_customer, p_company;
    END IF;

    IF p_interaction IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.interactions WHERE id = p_interaction AND company_id = p_company) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INTERACTION_COMPANY_MISMATCH: interaction % does not belong to company %', p_interaction, p_company;
    END IF;

    IF p_conversation IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.conversations WHERE id = p_conversation AND company_id = p_company) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONVERSATION_COMPANY_MISMATCH: conversation % does not belong to company %', p_conversation, p_company;
    END IF;

    -- 4. Idempotency check for leadgen_id
    IF p_meta_leadgen_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT id INTO v_existing_id
        FROM public.lead_attribution_touchpoints
        WHERE company_id = p_company
          AND meta_leadgen_id = p_meta_leadgen_id;

        IF v_existing_id IS NOT NULL THEN
            RETURN v_existing_id;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    -- 5. Look up snapshots from synced Meta Ads metadata if names are not provided
    IF p_meta_ad_id IS NOT NULL AND (v_resolved_ad IS NULL OR v_resolved_campaign_id IS NULL) THEN
        SELECT a.name, s.name, c.name, a.meta_campaign_id, a.meta_ad_set_id, a.ad_account_id
        INTO v_resolved_ad, v_resolved_ad_set, v_resolved_campaign, v_resolved_campaign_id, v_resolved_ad_set_id, p_ad_account_id
        FROM public.meta_ads a
        LEFT JOIN public.meta_ad_sets s ON s.company_id = p_company AND s.meta_ad_set_id = a.meta_ad_set_id
        LEFT JOIN public.meta_campaigns c ON c.company_id = p_company AND c.meta_campaign_id = a.meta_campaign_id
        WHERE a.company_id = p_company AND a.meta_ad_id = p_meta_ad_id;

        IF v_resolved_campaign IS NOT NULL AND v_status = 'UNATTRIBUTED' THEN
            v_status := 'ATTRIBUTED';
        END IF;
    END IF;

    -- Resolve ad_account_id from campaign if missing
    IF p_ad_account_id IS NULL AND v_resolved_campaign_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT c.ad_account_id INTO p_ad_account_id
        FROM public.meta_campaigns c
        WHERE c.company_id = p_company AND c.meta_campaign_id = v_resolved_campaign_id;
    END IF;

    IF p_meta_form_id IS NOT NULL AND v_resolved_form IS NULL THEN
        SELECT f.name INTO v_resolved_form
        FROM public.meta_lead_forms f
        WHERE f.company_id = p_company AND f.meta_form_id = p_meta_form_id;
    END IF;

    -- 6. STRICT ATTRIBUTION RULE (Priority 5)
    -- Do not label a lead ATTRIBUTED just because it has an ad_id unless that ad is successfully
    -- mapped to a trusted Meta campaign or valid attribution record.
    IF v_status = 'ATTRIBUTED' THEN
        IF COALESCE(v_resolved_campaign_id, p_meta_campaign_id) IS NULL AND COALESCE(v_resolved_campaign, p_campaign_name) IS NULL THEN
            v_status := 'UNATTRIBUTED';
        END IF;
    END IF;

    -- 7. Determine FIRST_TOUCH vs LATEST_TOUCH
    IF p_customer IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.lead_attribution_touchpoints
            WHERE company_id = p_company AND customer_id = p_customer
        ) INTO v_has_previous;

        IF v_has_previous THEN
            v_type := 'LATEST_TOUCH';
        ELSE
            v_type := 'FIRST_TOUCH';
        END IF;
    END IF;

    -- 8. Insert touchpoint
    INSERT INTO public.lead_attribution_touchpoints (
        company_id,
        customer_id,
        interaction_id,
        conversation_id,
        touchpoint_type,
        channel,
        page_id,
        page_name,
        ad_account_id,
        meta_campaign_id,
        campaign_name_snapshot,
        meta_ad_set_id,
        ad_set_name_snapshot,
        meta_ad_id,
        ad_name_snapshot,
        meta_form_id,
        form_name_snapshot,
        meta_leadgen_id,
        referral_source,
        referral_type,
        ads_context_data,
        utm_source,
        utm_medium,
        utm_campaign,
        utm_content,
        utm_term,
        fbclid,
        attribution_status,
        attribution_method,
        occurred_at,
        created_at
    )
    VALUES (
        p_company,
        p_customer,
        p_interaction,
        p_conversation,
        v_type,
        p_channel,
        p_page_id,
        p_page_name,
        p_ad_account_id,
        COALESCE(p_meta_campaign_id, v_resolved_campaign_id),
        v_resolved_campaign,
        COALESCE(p_meta_ad_set_id, v_resolved_ad_set_id),
        v_resolved_ad_set,
        p_meta_ad_id,
        v_resolved_ad,
        p_meta_form_id,
        v_resolved_form,
        p_meta_leadgen_id,
        p_referral_source,
        p_referral_type,
        p_ads_context_data,
        p_utm_source,
        p_utm_medium,
        p_utm_campaign,
        p_utm_content,
        p_utm_term,
        p_fbclid,
        v_status,
        p_attribution_method,
        COALESCE(p_occurred, now()),
        now()
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_touchpoint_id;

    -- 9. Update Customer snapshot fields atomically (First-touch strictly preserved)
    IF p_customer IS NOT NULL THEN
        IF NOT v_has_previous THEN
            UPDATE public.customers
            SET
                first_campaign_name = v_resolved_campaign,
                first_ad_name = v_resolved_ad,
                first_touch_at = COALESCE(p_occurred, now()),
                latest_campaign_name = v_resolved_campaign,
                latest_ad_name = v_resolved_ad,
                latest_touch_at = COALESCE(p_occurred, now()),
                attribution_status = v_status,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE id = p_customer AND company_id = p_company;
        ELSE
            UPDATE public.customers
            SET
                first_campaign_name = COALESCE(first_campaign_name, v_resolved_campaign),
                first_ad_name = COALESCE(first_ad_name, v_resolved_ad),
                latest_campaign_name = COALESCE(v_resolved_campaign, latest_campaign_name),
                latest_ad_name = COALESCE(v_resolved_ad, latest_ad_name),
                latest_touch_at = COALESCE(p_occurred, now()),
                attribution_status = CASE
                    WHEN v_status = 'ATTRIBUTED' THEN 'ATTRIBUTED'
                    ELSE attribution_status
                END,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE id = p_customer AND company_id = p_company;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    RETURN v_touchpoint_id;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_meta_ads_performance_report(
    p_company uuid,
    p_from timestamptz,
    p_to timestamptz,
    p_ad_account_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_campaign_id text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_total_spend numeric := 0;
    v_total_impressions bigint := 0;
    v_total_clicks bigint := 0;
    v_total_meta_leads integer := 0;
    v_total_crm_leads bigint := 0;
    v_total_attributed_leads bigint := 0;
    v_unique_attributed_customers bigint := 0;
    v_total_touchpoints bigint := 0;
    v_total_qualified_leads bigint := 0;
    v_ctr numeric := 0;
    v_cpl numeric := 0;
    v_cost_per_qualified numeric := 0;
    v_campaign_rows jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
BEGIN
    -- 1. STRICT AUTHORIZATION CHECK (Priority 2)
    IF auth.role() = 'authenticated' THEN
        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.company_members cm
            WHERE cm.company_id = p_company
              AND cm.user_id = auth.uid()
              AND cm.status = 'ACTIVE'
        ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNAUTHORIZED_COMPANY_ACCESS: user % not authorized for company %', auth.uid(), p_company;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    -- 2. Verify company exists
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.companies WHERE id = p_company) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_COMPANY_ID: company % does not exist', p_company;
    END IF;

    -- 3. Consistent Meta daily insights aggregation (Priority 6)
    -- When p_campaign_id is specified, aggregate from CAMPAIGN level rows; otherwise ACCOUNT level rows
    IF p_campaign_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT
            COALESCE(SUM(spend), 0),
            COALESCE(SUM(impressions), 0),
            COALESCE(SUM(clicks), 0),
            COALESCE(SUM(meta_leads), 0)
        INTO
            v_total_spend,
            v_total_impressions,
            v_total_clicks,
            v_total_meta_leads
        FROM public.meta_insights_daily
        WHERE company_id = p_company
          AND date >= p_from::date
          AND date <= p_to::date
          AND entity_type = 'CAMPAIGN'
          AND entity_id = p_campaign_id
          AND (p_ad_account_id IS NULL OR ad_account_id = p_ad_account_id);
    ELSE
        SELECT
            COALESCE(SUM(spend), 0),
            COALESCE(SUM(impressions), 0),
            COALESCE(SUM(clicks), 0),
            COALESCE(SUM(meta_leads), 0)
        INTO
            v_total_spend,
            v_total_impressions,
            v_total_clicks,
            v_total_meta_leads
        FROM public.meta_insights_daily
        WHERE company_id = p_company
          AND date >= p_from::date
          AND date <= p_to::date
          AND entity_type = 'ACCOUNT'
          AND (p_ad_account_id IS NULL OR ad_account_id = p_ad_account_id);
    END IF;

    -- 4. Calculate CTR
    IF v_total_impressions > 0 THEN
        v_ctr := ROUND((v_total_clicks::numeric / v_total_impressions::numeric) * 100, 2);
    ELSE
        v_ctr := 0;
    END IF;

    -- 5. Aggregate CRM metrics separately (Priority 6)
    -- A: Total distinct CRM leads (counting distinct leadgen ID / customer ID)
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(t.customer_id::text, t.meta_leadgen_id, t.id::text))
    INTO v_total_crm_leads
    FROM public.lead_attribution_touchpoints t
    WHERE t.company_id = p_company
      AND t.occurred_at >= p_from
      AND t.occurred_at <= p_to
      AND (
          p_ad_account_id IS NULL
          OR t.ad_account_id = p_ad_account_id
          OR (t.ad_account_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM public.meta_campaigns mc
              WHERE mc.company_id = t.company_id AND mc.meta_campaign_id = t.meta_campaign_id AND mc.ad_account_id = p_ad_account_id
          ))
      )
      AND (p_campaign_id IS NULL OR t.meta_campaign_id = p_campaign_id);

    -- B: Total distinct Attributed leads
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(t.customer_id::text, t.meta_leadgen_id, t.id::text))
    INTO v_total_attributed_leads
    FROM public.lead_attribution_touchpoints t
    WHERE t.company_id = p_company
      AND t.occurred_at >= p_from
      AND t.occurred_at <= p_to
      AND t.attribution_status = 'ATTRIBUTED'
      AND (
          p_ad_account_id IS NULL
          OR t.ad_account_id = p_ad_account_id
          OR (t.ad_account_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM public.meta_campaigns mc
              WHERE mc.company_id = t.company_id AND mc.meta_campaign_id = t.meta_campaign_id AND mc.ad_account_id = p_ad_account_id
          ))
      )
      AND (p_campaign_id IS NULL OR t.meta_campaign_id = p_campaign_id);

    -- C: Unique Attributed Customers
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.customer_id)
    INTO v_unique_attributed_customers
    FROM public.lead_attribution_touchpoints t
    WHERE t.company_id = p_company
      AND t.occurred_at >= p_from
      AND t.occurred_at <= p_to
      AND t.attribution_status = 'ATTRIBUTED'
      AND t.customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          p_ad_account_id IS NULL
          OR t.ad_account_id = p_ad_account_id
          OR (t.ad_account_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM public.meta_campaigns mc
              WHERE mc.company_id = t.company_id AND mc.meta_campaign_id = t.meta_campaign_id AND mc.ad_account_id = p_ad_account_id
          ))
      )
      AND (p_campaign_id IS NULL OR t.meta_campaign_id = p_campaign_id);

    -- D: Total Touchpoints
    SELECT COUNT(t.id)
    INTO v_total_touchpoints
    FROM public.lead_attribution_touchpoints t
    WHERE t.company_id = p_company
      AND t.occurred_at >= p_from
      AND t.occurred_at <= p_to
      AND (
          p_ad_account_id IS NULL
          OR t.ad_account_id = p_ad_account_id
          OR (t.ad_account_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM public.meta_campaigns mc
              WHERE mc.company_id = t.company_id AND mc.meta_campaign_id = t.meta_campaign_id AND mc.ad_account_id = p_ad_account_id
          ))
      )
      AND (p_campaign_id IS NULL OR t.meta_campaign_id = p_campaign_id);

    -- E: Calculate CPL (Safe division by unique attributed leads)
    IF v_total_attributed_leads > 0 THEN
        v_cpl := ROUND(v_total_spend / v_total_attributed_leads, 0);
    ELSE
        v_cpl := 0;
    END IF;

    -- F: Aggregate Qualified Leads (distinct customers with ATTRIBUTED touchpoint in qualified stages)
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)
    INTO v_total_qualified_leads
    FROM public.lead_attribution_touchpoints t
    JOIN public.customers c ON c.id = t.customer_id AND c.company_id = p_company
    WHERE t.company_id = p_company
      AND t.occurred_at >= p_from
      AND t.occurred_at <= p_to
      AND t.attribution_status = 'ATTRIBUTED'
      AND c.stage IN ('INTERESTED', 'HIGH_POTENTIAL', 'DEPOSIT_PENDING', 'DEPOSIT_CONFIRMED', 'CONTRACT_SIGNED', 'interested', 'deep_research', 'high_potential', 'contract_signed')
      AND (
          p_ad_account_id IS NULL
          OR t.ad_account_id = p_ad_account_id
          OR (t.ad_account_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM public.meta_campaigns mc
              WHERE mc.company_id = t.company_id AND mc.meta_campaign_id = t.meta_campaign_id AND mc.ad_account_id = p_ad_account_id
          ))
      )
      AND (p_campaign_id IS NULL OR t.meta_campaign_id = p_campaign_id);

    IF v_total_qualified_leads > 0 THEN
        v_cost_per_qualified := ROUND(v_total_spend / v_total_qualified_leads, 0);
    ELSE
        v_cost_per_qualified := 0;
    END IF;

    -- 6. Campaign breakdown (Pre-aggregated to prevent Cartesian products)
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(sub), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_campaign_rows
    FROM (
        SELECT
            c.meta_campaign_id AS campaign_id,
            c.name AS campaign_name,
            c.status AS campaign_status,
            COALESCE(ins.spend, 0) AS spend,
            COALESCE(ins.impressions, 0) AS impressions,
            COALESCE(ins.clicks, 0) AS clicks,
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(ins.impressions, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(ins.clicks, 0)::numeric / ins.impressions::numeric) * 100, 2)
                ELSE 0
            END AS ctr,
            COALESCE(ins.meta_leads, 0) AS meta_leads,
            COALESCE(crm.crm_leads, 0) AS crm_leads,
            COALESCE(crm.attributed_leads, 0) AS attributed_leads,
            COALESCE(crm.unique_customers, 0) AS unique_customers,
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(crm.attributed_leads, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(ins.spend, 0) / crm.attributed_leads, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END AS cpl
        FROM public.meta_campaigns c
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT
                entity_id,
                SUM(spend) AS spend,
                SUM(impressions) AS impressions,
                SUM(clicks) AS clicks,
                SUM(meta_leads) AS meta_leads
            FROM public.meta_insights_daily
            WHERE company_id = p_company
              AND date >= p_from::date
              AND date <= p_to::date
              AND entity_type = 'CAMPAIGN'
            GROUP BY entity_id
        ) ins ON ins.entity_id = c.meta_campaign_id
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT
                meta_campaign_id,
                COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(customer_id::text, meta_leadgen_id, id::text)) AS crm_leads,
                COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(customer_id::text, meta_leadgen_id, id::text)) FILTER (WHERE attribution_status = 'ATTRIBUTED') AS attributed_leads,
                COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FILTER (WHERE attribution_status = 'ATTRIBUTED' AND customer_id IS NOT NULL) AS unique_customers
            FROM public.lead_attribution_touchpoints
            WHERE company_id = p_company
              AND occurred_at >= p_from
              AND occurred_at <= p_to
            GROUP BY meta_campaign_id
        ) crm ON crm.meta_campaign_id = c.meta_campaign_id
        WHERE c.company_id = p_company
          AND (p_ad_account_id IS NULL OR c.ad_account_id = p_ad_account_id)
          AND (p_campaign_id IS NULL OR c.meta_campaign_id = p_campaign_id)
        ORDER BY spend DESC, crm_leads DESC
    ) sub;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'overview', jsonb_build_object(
            'spend', v_total_spend,
            'impressions', v_total_impressions,
            'clicks', v_total_clicks,
            'ctr', v_ctr,
            'meta_leads', v_total_meta_leads,
            'crm_leads', v_total_crm_leads,
            'attributed_leads', v_total_attributed_leads,
            'unique_customers', v_unique_attributed_customers,
            'total_touchpoints', v_total_touchpoints,
            'qualified_leads', v_total_qualified_leads,
            'cpl', v_cpl,
            'cost_per_qualified', v_cost_per_qualified
        ),
        'campaigns', v_campaign_rows
    );
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.han_ingest(
    p_company uuid,
    p_channel text,
    p_external text,
    p_key text,
    p_name text,
    p_phone text,
    p_content text,
    p_safe text,
    p_safe_status text,
    p_occurred timestamptz,
    p_payload jsonb
)
    RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_customer uuid;
  v_phone_customer uuid;
  v_conversation uuid;
  v_interaction uuid;
  v_existing private.han_intake_events%ROWTYPE;
  v_contact text;
  v_review boolean := false;
BEGIN
  IF p_channel IS NULL OR p_channel NOT IN ('FACEBOOK', 'WEBSITE')
    OR p_safe_status IS NULL OR p_safe_status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED')
    OR (p_channel = 'FACEBOOK' AND (p_external IS NULL OR (
        p_external !~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+$' AND NOT (
            p_external ~ '^[0-9]+:leadgen:[0-9]+$' AND p_key=p_external AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM private.meta_leadgen_events e WHERE e.company_id=p_company
                    AND e.page_id=split_part(p_external,':',1) AND e.leadgen_id=split_part(p_external,':',3)
                    AND e.status='PROCESSING' AND e.lease_until>clock_timestamp()
            )
        )
    )))
    OR (p_channel = 'WEBSITE' AND p_external IS NOT NULL)
    OR p_key IS NULL OR length(p_key) = 0
    OR p_content IS NULL OR p_name IS NULL
    OR length(p_external) > 250
    OR length(p_key) > 500
    OR length(p_content) > 10000
    OR length(p_name) > 100
    OR (p_safe_status = 'FAILED' AND p_safe IS NOT NULL)
    OR (p_safe_status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND p_safe IS NULL)
    OR (
      p_phone IS NOT NULL
      AND p_phone !~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$'
    )
    OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.companies
      WHERE id = p_company AND status = 'ACTIVE'
    )
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_REQUEST';
  END IF;

  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    hashtextextended('han-intake:' || p_company::text, 0)
  );

  SELECT * INTO v_existing
  FROM private.han_intake_events
  WHERE company_id = p_company
    AND channel = p_channel
    AND event_key = p_key;

  IF FOUND THEN
    IF v_existing.external_identity IS DISTINCT FROM p_external
      OR v_existing.payload->>'content' IS DISTINCT FROM p_content
      OR v_existing.payload->>'phone' IS DISTINCT FROM p_phone
      OR v_existing.payload->>'name' IS DISTINCT FROM p_name
      OR (p_channel = 'WEBSITE' AND v_existing.payload->'source' IS DISTINCT FROM p_payload)
    THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT';
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'status', v_existing.status,
      'interaction_id', v_existing.interaction_id
    );
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO private.han_intake_events
  VALUES (
    p_company,
    p_channel,
    p_key,
    p_external,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'source', p_payload,
      'content', p_content,
      'phone', p_phone,
      'name', p_name,
      'occurred_at', p_occurred
    ),
    'RECEIVED',
    NULL,
    now()
  );

  SELECT customer_id INTO v_customer
  FROM public.identities
  WHERE company_id = p_company
    AND channel = p_channel
    AND external_id = p_external
    AND p_channel = 'FACEBOOK';

  IF p_phone IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT customer_id INTO v_phone_customer
    FROM private.customer_private_contacts
    WHERE company_id = p_company
      AND normalized_phone = p_phone;
  END IF;

  IF v_customer IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT normalized_phone INTO v_contact
    FROM private.customer_private_contacts
    WHERE company_id = p_company
      AND customer_id = v_customer;
  END IF;

  -- Danh tính mâu thuẫn: giữ tin, không tự gộp/sửa liên hệ.
  IF (
    v_phone_customer IS NOT NULL
    AND v_customer IS DISTINCT FROM v_phone_customer
  ) OR (
    v_contact IS NOT NULL
    AND p_phone IS NOT NULL
    AND v_contact <> p_phone
  ) THEN
    v_review := true;
    UPDATE private.han_intake_events
    SET status = 'IDENTITY_REVIEW'
    WHERE company_id = p_company
      AND channel = p_channel
      AND event_key = p_key;
  END IF;

  IF v_customer IS NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.customers (
      company_id, name, source, stage
    )
    VALUES (
      p_company, p_name, p_channel, 'LEAD_NEW'
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_customer;

    INSERT INTO public.customer_stage_histories (
      company_id, customer_id, from_stage,
      to_stage, actor_type, reason
    )
    VALUES (
      p_company, v_customer, NULL,
      'LEAD_NEW', 'SYSTEM', 'OMNICHANNEL_INTAKE'
    );
  END IF;

  -- Website submissions are intake events, not persistent person identities.
  IF v_review THEN
    INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (
      company_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, customer_id, result
    ) VALUES (
      p_company, 'OMNICHANNEL_IDENTITY_REVIEW', 'Customer',
      v_customer, v_customer, 'SUCCESS'
    );
  END IF;

  IF p_channel = 'FACEBOOK' THEN
    INSERT INTO public.identities (
      company_id, customer_id, channel,
      external_id, verified
    )
    VALUES (
      p_company, v_customer, p_channel,
      p_external, false
    )
    ON CONFLICT (company_id, channel, external_id)
    DO NOTHING;
  END IF;

  IF p_phone IS NOT NULL
    AND v_phone_customer IS NULL
    AND v_contact IS NULL
  THEN
    INSERT INTO private.customer_private_contacts (
      company_id, customer_id,
      normalized_phone, raw_phone, is_verified
    )
    VALUES (
      p_company, v_customer, p_phone, p_phone, false
    );
  END IF;

  IF p_channel = 'FACEBOOK' THEN
    INSERT INTO public.conversations (
      company_id, customer_id, channel,
      external_conversation_id,
      last_message_at, unread_count
    )
    VALUES (
      p_company, v_customer, 'FACEBOOK',
      p_external, p_occurred, 1
    )
    ON CONFLICT (
      company_id, channel, external_conversation_id
    )
    DO UPDATE SET
      last_message_at = greatest(
        public.conversations.last_message_at,
        excluded.last_message_at
      ),
      unread_count = public.conversations.unread_count + 1
    RETURNING id INTO v_conversation;
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.interactions (
    company_id, customer_id, conversation_id,
    channel, type, direction,
    sanitized_content, sanitization_status,
    sanitized_at, sanitizer_version,
    external_ref, actor_type, created_at
  )
  VALUES (
    p_company, v_customer, v_conversation,
    p_channel, 'MESSAGE', 'INBOUND',
    p_safe, p_safe_status,
    CASE WHEN p_safe_status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN now() END,
    'han-bounded-v2',
    p_key, 'CUSTOMER', p_occurred
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_interaction;

  INSERT INTO private.interaction_raw_contents (
    interaction_id, company_id, raw_content, raw_payload
  )
  VALUES (
    v_interaction, p_company, p_content, p_payload
  );

  UPDATE private.han_intake_events
  SET
    status = CASE
      WHEN status = 'IDENTITY_REVIEW' THEN status
      ELSE 'PROCESSED'
    END,
    interaction_id = v_interaction
  WHERE company_id = p_company
    AND channel = p_channel
    AND event_key = p_key;

  -- Quy ước: phản hồi cho lượt chăm sóc gần nhất trong 7 ngày.
  IF p_channel = 'FACEBOOK' THEN
    UPDATE public.care_deliveries
    SET responded_at = p_occurred, status = 'RESPONDED'
    WHERE id = (
      SELECT d.id
      FROM public.care_deliveries d
      JOIN private.han_outbox o ON o.care_delivery_id = d.id
      WHERE d.company_id = p_company
        AND d.customer_id = v_customer
        AND d.channel = 'FACEBOOK'
        AND o.conversation_id = v_conversation
        AND d.sent_at <= p_occurred
        AND d.sent_at > p_occurred - interval '7 days'
        AND d.status IN (
          'SENT', 'DELIVERED', 'READ',
          'RESPONDED', 'CONVERTED_TO_SALE'
        )
      ORDER BY d.sent_at DESC
      LIMIT 1
    )
    AND responded_at IS NULL
    AND status <> 'CONVERTED_TO_SALE';
  END IF;

  -- TV9 SLA WIRING: Atomically open or reuse Response SLA window for Facebook inbound message
  IF p_channel = 'FACEBOOK' AND p_external ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+$' AND v_conversation IS NOT NULL THEN
    PERFORM public.open_response_sla_window(
      p_company,
      v_conversation,
      v_interaction
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'status', 'ACCEPTED',
    'interaction_id', v_interaction
  );
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_lead_attribution_touchpoint(
    p_company uuid,
    p_customer uuid DEFAULT NULL,
    p_interaction uuid DEFAULT NULL,
    p_conversation uuid DEFAULT NULL,
    p_channel text DEFAULT 'FACEBOOK_LEAD_ADS',
    p_page_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_page_name text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_ad_account_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_meta_campaign_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_campaign_name text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_meta_ad_set_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_ad_set_name text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_meta_ad_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_ad_name text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_meta_form_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_form_name text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_meta_leadgen_id text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_referral_source text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_referral_type text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_ads_context_data jsonb DEFAULT NULL,
    p_utm_source text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_utm_medium text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_utm_campaign text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_utm_content text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_utm_term text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_fbclid text DEFAULT NULL,
    p_attribution_status text DEFAULT 'UNATTRIBUTED',
    p_attribution_method text DEFAULT 'DIRECT_LEADGEN',
    p_occurred timestamptz DEFAULT now()
)
RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_touchpoint_id uuid;
    v_has_previous boolean := false;
    v_type text := 'FIRST_TOUCH';
    v_existing_id uuid;
    v_resolved_campaign_id text;
    v_resolved_ad_set_id text;
    v_resolved_campaign text;
    v_resolved_ad_set text;
    v_resolved_ad text;
    v_resolved_form text;
    v_status text := 'UNATTRIBUTED';
    v_account_id text;
    v_raw jsonb;
    v_occurred timestamptz := COALESCE(p_occurred,now());
BEGIN
    -- 1. STRICT AUTHORIZATION CHECK (Priority 2)
    IF auth.role() = 'authenticated' THEN
        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.company_members cm
            WHERE cm.company_id = p_company
              AND cm.user_id = auth.uid()
              AND cm.status = 'ACTIVE'
        ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNAUTHORIZED_COMPANY_ACCESS: user % not authorized for company %', auth.uid(), p_company;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    -- 2. Verify company exists
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.companies WHERE id = p_company) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_COMPANY_ID: company % does not exist', p_company;
    END IF;

    -- 3. Scope validation for foreign keys
    IF p_customer IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.customers WHERE id = p_customer AND company_id = p_company) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CUSTOMER_COMPANY_MISMATCH: customer % does not belong to company %', p_customer, p_company;
    END IF;

    IF p_interaction IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.interactions WHERE id = p_interaction AND company_id = p_company) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INTERACTION_COMPANY_MISMATCH: interaction % does not belong to company %', p_interaction, p_company;
    END IF;

    IF p_conversation IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.conversations WHERE id = p_conversation AND company_id = p_company) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONVERSATION_COMPANY_MISMATCH: conversation % does not belong to company %', p_conversation, p_company;
    END IF;

    -- Serialize duplicate leadgen AND first-touch writers (including distinct leads for one customer).
    IF p_meta_leadgen_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('meta-attribution:'||p_company::text||':'||p_meta_leadgen_id,0));
    END IF;
    IF p_customer IS NOT NULL THEN
        PERFORM 1 FROM public.customers WHERE id=p_customer AND company_id=p_company FOR UPDATE;
    END IF;
    IF p_meta_leadgen_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT id INTO v_existing_id FROM public.lead_attribution_touchpoints
            WHERE company_id=p_company AND meta_leadgen_id=p_meta_leadgen_id;
        IF FOUND THEN RETURN v_existing_id; END IF;
    ELSIF p_interaction IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT id INTO v_existing_id FROM public.lead_attribution_touchpoints
            WHERE company_id=p_company AND interaction_id=p_interaction AND channel=p_channel;
        IF FOUND THEN RETURN v_existing_id; END IF;
    END IF;

    -- Names/status in a webhook are assertions, never evidence. Resolve all snapshots
    -- exclusively from server-synced records in this company and the same ad account.
    IF p_meta_ad_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT c.meta_campaign_id,c.name,a.meta_ad_set_id,s.name,a.name,c.ad_account_id
        INTO v_resolved_campaign_id,v_resolved_campaign,v_resolved_ad_set_id,v_resolved_ad_set,v_resolved_ad,v_account_id
        FROM public.meta_ads a
        JOIN public.meta_campaigns c ON c.company_id=a.company_id AND c.meta_campaign_id=a.meta_campaign_id AND c.ad_account_id=a.ad_account_id
        LEFT JOIN public.meta_ad_sets s ON s.company_id=a.company_id AND s.meta_ad_set_id=a.meta_ad_set_id
            AND s.meta_campaign_id=c.meta_campaign_id AND s.ad_account_id=c.ad_account_id
        WHERE a.company_id=p_company AND a.meta_ad_id=p_meta_ad_id;
    ELSIF p_meta_campaign_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT c.meta_campaign_id,c.name,c.ad_account_id
        INTO v_resolved_campaign_id,v_resolved_campaign,v_account_id
        FROM public.meta_campaigns c WHERE c.company_id=p_company AND c.meta_campaign_id=p_meta_campaign_id;
    END IF;
    IF v_resolved_campaign_id IS NOT NULL THEN v_status := 'ATTRIBUTED'; END IF;
    IF p_meta_form_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT f.name INTO v_resolved_form FROM public.meta_lead_forms f
            WHERE f.company_id=p_company AND f.meta_form_id=p_meta_form_id
                AND (p_page_id IS NULL OR f.page_id=p_page_id);
    END IF;
    -- Keep unverified identifiers separately for reconciliation; never put them in
    -- campaign report keys or snapshots when mapping failed.
    v_raw := COALESCE(p_ads_context_data,'{}'::jsonb)||jsonb_build_object('raw_meta',jsonb_build_object(
        'campaign_id',p_meta_campaign_id,'campaign_name',p_campaign_name,'ad_account_id',p_ad_account_id,
        'adset_id',p_meta_ad_set_id,'adset_name',p_ad_set_name,'ad_id',p_meta_ad_id,'ad_name',p_ad_name,
        'form_id',p_meta_form_id,'form_name',p_form_name));

    -- 7. Determine FIRST_TOUCH vs LATEST_TOUCH
    IF p_customer IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.lead_attribution_touchpoints
            WHERE company_id = p_company AND customer_id = p_customer
        ) INTO v_has_previous;

        IF v_has_previous THEN
            v_type := 'LATEST_TOUCH';
        ELSE
            v_type := 'FIRST_TOUCH';
        END IF;
    END IF;

    -- 8. Insert touchpoint
    INSERT INTO public.lead_attribution_touchpoints (
        company_id,
        customer_id,
        interaction_id,
        conversation_id,
        touchpoint_type,
        channel,
        page_id,
        page_name,
        ad_account_id,
        meta_campaign_id,
        campaign_name_snapshot,
        meta_ad_set_id,
        ad_set_name_snapshot,
        meta_ad_id,
        ad_name_snapshot,
        meta_form_id,
        form_name_snapshot,
        meta_leadgen_id,
        referral_source,
        referral_type,
        ads_context_data,
        utm_source,
        utm_medium,
        utm_campaign,
        utm_content,
        utm_term,
        fbclid,
        attribution_status,
        attribution_method,
        occurred_at,
        created_at
    )
    VALUES (
        p_company,
        p_customer,
        p_interaction,
        p_conversation,
        v_type,
        p_channel,
        p_page_id,
        p_page_name,
        v_account_id,
        v_resolved_campaign_id,
        v_resolved_campaign,
        v_resolved_ad_set_id,
        v_resolved_ad_set,
        p_meta_ad_id,
        v_resolved_ad,
        p_meta_form_id,
        v_resolved_form,
        p_meta_leadgen_id,
        p_referral_source,
        p_referral_type,
        v_raw,
        p_utm_source,
        p_utm_medium,
        p_utm_campaign,
        p_utm_content,
        p_utm_term,
        p_fbclid,
        v_status,
        p_attribution_method,
        v_occurred,
        now()
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_touchpoint_id;

    -- 9. Update Customer snapshot fields atomically (First-touch strictly preserved)
    IF p_customer IS NOT NULL THEN
        IF NOT v_has_previous THEN
            UPDATE public.customers
            SET
                first_campaign_name = v_resolved_campaign,
                first_ad_name = v_resolved_ad,
                first_touch_at = v_occurred,
                latest_campaign_name = v_resolved_campaign,
                latest_ad_name = v_resolved_ad,
                latest_touch_at = v_occurred,
                attribution_status = v_status,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE id = p_customer AND company_id = p_company;
        ELSE
            UPDATE public.customers
            SET latest_campaign_name=v_resolved_campaign, latest_ad_name=v_resolved_ad,
                latest_touch_at=v_occurred, attribution_status=v_status, updated_at=now()
            WHERE id=p_customer AND company_id=p_company AND (latest_touch_at IS NULL OR latest_touch_at<=v_occurred);
        END IF;
    END IF;

    RETURN v_touchpoint_id;
END;
$$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.release_meta_ad_account_sync_lease(
    p_company_id uuid,
    p_ad_account_id text,
    p_lease_token uuid,
    p_status text,
    p_error text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE v_rows integer;
BEGIN
    IF p_status IS NULL OR p_status NOT IN ('SUCCESS','FAILED') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_SYNC_STATUS'; END IF;
    -- Authorization check for authenticated users
    IF auth.role() = 'authenticated' THEN
        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.company_members cm
            WHERE cm.company_id = p_company_id
              AND cm.user_id = auth.uid()
              AND cm.status = 'ACTIVE'
        ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNAUTHORIZED_COMPANY_ACCESS: user % not authorized for company %', auth.uid(), p_company_id;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.meta_ad_accounts
    SET
        sync_status = p_status,
        sync_error = p_error,
        sync_lease_token = NULL,
        sync_lease_until = NULL,
        last_synced_at = CASE WHEN p_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN now() ELSE last_synced_at END,
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE company_id = p_company_id
      AND ad_account_id = p_ad_account_id
      AND sync_lease_token = p_lease_token AND sync_lease_until > clock_timestamp();
    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;
    RETURN v_rows=1;
END;
$$;
